providers.description: Searoutes is a maritime routing and carbon-emissions API platform for logistics, freight forwarding, and supply-chain teams. Its REST APIs compute point-to-point, port-to-point, and port-to-port sea routes with distances and durations (including SECA, HRA, and ice-area avoidance), geocode ports, airports, and places, calculate multimodal CO2e emissions (sea, road, rail, air, inland waterway) using a GLEC-accredited methodology, track vessels via AIS (positions, ETAs, traces, arrivals), look up carriers and services, and return historical, real-time, and forecasted weather along routes. All APIs are served from https://api.searoutes.com and authenticated with an x-api-key header.

providers.name: AMPAworks
providers.description: AMPAworks builds AI-powered smart-shelf inventory management for healthcare and defense supply chains. Its platform pairs computer-vision cameras and rolling kiosks that image inventory to auto-count stock in real time with software that tracks supplies 24/7, automates reordering, and gives teams live visibility to prevent stock-outs. The company reports outcomes such as $15M in cost reduction, 25,000 hours saved on hand counting, and 72% fewer stock-outs across more than 28 healthcare and operational organizations. Backed by 500 Global, AMPAworks operates from offices in Santa Monica CA, Buffalo NY, Hackensack NJ, and Ann Arbor MI.

providers.name: Choco
providers.description: Choco is an AI-powered digital ordering platform that simplifies how restaurants order from their food suppliers and distributors. Serving tens of thousands of distributors and over one hundred thousand buyers across the US, UK, Europe, and the GCC, Choco lets restaurateurs place orders and chat with all their suppliers in one app while converting orders into a supplier's preferred format (email, WhatsApp, text, fax, or direct ERP integration). Choco connects to supplier ERP systems such as Entree, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, Target Data System, NCR, Sage, and Odoo, and uses AI — including OrderAgent for multimodal order capture and VoiceAgent built on OpenAI's Realtime API — to turn emails, texts, images, and documents into structured, ERP-ready orders. Choco does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP connections, and its public GitHub organization (chocoapp) hosts only internal data-engineering and infrastructure tooling rather than client SDKs or API specifications.

providers.name: Outgo
providers.description: Outgo provides freight factoring services, offering low rates, fast funding speeds, and a next‑generation financial platform that integrates banking, debit cards, and broker payments for the freight industry. It enables owner‑operators and fleets to get instant cash flow, automate invoicing, and access a suite of logistics‑focused financial tools.

providers.name: xChange
providers.description: Container xChange is a Hamburg-founded B2B online marketplace and operating platform for shipping containers, where container owners, users, traders, and lessors buy, sell, and lease standard and special containers worldwide. The platform covers container trading, one-way and long-term leasing, payment handling via the xChange Wallet, insurance, container tracking, and market-price insights, plus a live North America container inventory storefront. xChange publishes no public developer API; its xChange Connect integrations (customer supply-listing feeds and depot container-movement reporting) accept data via API or spreadsheet but are onboarded privately through an account manager.

providers.name: Fictiv
providers.description: Fictiv is a digital manufacturing and supply chain platform that connects engineering and hardware teams with a vetted global network of manufacturers to source custom mechanical parts. It provides instant online quoting, automated design-for-manufacturability (DFM) analysis, and end-to-end order visibility across CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, sheet metal, urethane casting, and compression molding — from rapid prototyping through full-scale production. Now part of MISUMI, Fictiv operates a quote-to-order web platform at app.fictiv.com; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Regrello
providers.description: Regrello is an AI operating system for manufacturing and supply chain operations, giving teams that are stuck in email and stifled by decades-old ERPs an agentic AI platform to accelerate innovation and productivity. Its product, Agentforce Operations, orchestrates enterprise manufacturing and supply chain workflows with generative AI. Regrello was acquired by Salesforce and is backed by a16z and Bloomberg Beta. This profile currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network for its identity, security posture, and published compliance program.

providers.name: Frete.com
providers.description: Frete.com is the Brazilian road-freight technology group formed in January 2023 when CargoX merged with Fretebras and FretePago, becoming Latin America's largest freight-matching platform and one of Brazil's logistics unicorns after a US$200M round led by SoftBank and Tencent. The group operates three consumer-facing brands: Fretebras, the freight marketplace that connects shippers and carriers with autonomous truck drivers; CargoX Brasil, which bundles working-capital credit, cargo insurance, document issuance and truck tracking for trucking companies; and FretePago, a fintech offering a digital account and freight payment rails for drivers and fleets. It also acquired Rotas Brasil for route mapping and toll pricing. The platform applies machine learning to freight matching, fraud and cargo-theft prevention, and pricing intelligence. Frete.com does not currently publish a public developer portal or machine-readable API contract; the Fretebras integration API is reached through partner and ERP/TMS channels rather than an open reference.

providers.name: Mercado Libre
providers.description: Mercado Libre is the largest e-commerce marketplace in Latin America with adjacent fintech (Mercado Pago), logistics (Mercado Envios), and ads businesses. The developer platform exposes REST APIs for items, orders, shipments, users, payments, and seller tooling.

providers.name: Xpedeon
providers.description: Xpedeon is a construction-specific ERP platform from Algorithms Software Pvt Ltd (30+ years in construction software), serving general contractors, specialist contractors, housebuilders and developers, engineer-to-order manufacturers, and off-site manufacturers across the UK, India, the GCC, and the US. The cloud platform covers construction finance and accounting, job costing and CVR, contract and subcontractor management, procurement, inventory and supply chain, plant and equipment, warehouse management, HR and payroll, CRM, and a mobile app for site teams, and is ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701 and SOC 2 certified. Xpedeon publishes no public API, developer portal, or integration documentation, but does publish an llms.txt. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: 2ULaundry
providers.description: 2ULaundry is a laundry and dry cleaning pickup-and-delivery service headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina and backed by Techstars. Customers schedule pickups through a mobile app, leave color-coded bags at their door, and receive cleaned items back within one to two business days. Services include residential wash-and-fold, delicate garment care, dry cleaning, and household linens, plus commercial laundry solutions for Airbnbs, spas, gyms, salons, and healthcare facilities. The company operates its own processing facilities and a fleet-based delivery network across its Southeast US markets. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the Techstars portfolio and enriched; 2ULaundry is a consumer service company and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Certa
providers.description: Certa (operated by Opinr, Inc. d/b/a Certa) is an AI-native third-party risk management (TPRM) and compliance platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle — onboarding, due diligence, contract management, continuous compliance monitoring, and offboarding — in a single no-code system. Founded by Jag Lamba and headquartered in Saratoga, CA, Certa serves Fortune 500 companies (Honeywell, Uber, Mars, Box, Quantcast) across 120+ countries and 17 languages. The platform covers all risk domains — operational and resilience, infosec and cyber, compliance and legal, financial and credit, reputational, geopolitical, and ESG and ethical risk — via its Studio no-code process designer, Certa Connect (130+ native integrations), and embedded AI agents. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools. External integration is available through an enterprise external API surfaced from the platform; no public OpenAPI or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Scalera
providers.description: Scalera AG is a Swiss construction-technology company building an AI platform that automates the tender and quotation process for the construction industry across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). Its product-matching engine extracts positions from tender documents (PDF, GAEB, Excel/CSV, XML, email) and matches them against supplier product catalogs, while its supplier-matching tools help contractors identify relevant manufacturers and send structured inquiries. Scalera integrates with ERP, CRM, and PIM systems and serves 200+ manufacturers, processors, and traders. Backed by Speedinvest, it positions itself as one of Europe's most funded construction-tech startups. This profile documents the company's public web surface; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: TeamCentral
providers.description: TeamCentral provides an AI‑powered integration platform that connects enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, WMS, and TMS into a unified data layer. Their CORBI AI agent automates data synchronization, offers real‑time insights, and supports no‑code workflow building for supply‑chain intelligence, finance, and operations. The platform emphasizes secure, governed data exchange and AI readiness across a wide range of connectors and industry solutions, targeting large enterprises seeking to streamline processes and leverage AI at scale.

providers.name: Vertice
providers.description: Vertice is an intelligent procurement platform built for the modern enterprise with agentic workflows, AI insights, and expert buyers that empower finance and procurement teams across 30+ countries to buy smarter and scale faster. The platform covers SaaS purchasing and contract management, cloud spend optimization (AWS, GCP, Azure), and integrates with ERPs, CLMs, ticketing platforms, communication tools, TPRM systems, and SSOs to centralize procurement workflows. Vertice processes over $30B in spend with proven 20%+ savings for customers including ARM, Blackberry, Factorial, and Santander.

providers.name: Ambi Robotics
providers.description: Ambi Robotics is a Berkeley, California AI robotics company building parcel-sortation and induction robots for ecommerce, postal, and logistics workflows. Founded in 2018 as Ambidextrous Laboratories — a spin-out of UC Berkeley's Dex-Net Project led by Ken Goldberg — by Jeff Mahler (CTO), Stephen McKinley, David Gealy, and Matt Matl, with Jim Liefer (ex-Walmart, ex-UPS) as CEO. Its flagship products are AmbiSort A-Series (sort-to-sack small parcel sorting), AmbiSort B-Series (sort-to-gaylord parcel induction for middle-mile and reverse logistics), AmbiStack (mixed-case stacking for inbound and outbound), and AmbiVision (3D dimensioning, OCR, defect detection, and visual quality inspection). All robots run AmbiOS, the company's cloud-native "operating system for physical intelligence," comprising the AI Skill Suite (Sort, Stack, Kit, Pack, Induct apps), the PRIME-1 foundation model trained on millions of real-world operations, AmbiVision perception, AmbiAccess fleet management dashboard with heat maps and remote support, and a Sim2Real training pipeline that compresses model training by up to 10,000x. Ambi Robotics' primary commercial deployment is a $23 million expansion with Pitney Bowes, with AmbiSort A-Series and B-Series systems deployed across Pitney Bowes ecommerce hubs in the US (including the Stockton, CA hub that nearly doubled local-direct-delivery throughput in the 2021 peak holiday season, and middle-mile B-Series systems that sorted more than 3 million parcels within four months of deployment). Ambi Robotics does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for AmbiOS, AmbiSort, AmbiStack, or PRIME-1; integration with customer WMS/WES systems is performed by Ambi's solutions team. The company's public GitHub org primarily contains forks of infrastructure tooling (Ray, trimesh, FCL, EIPScanner, tinygltf, rapier, jszmq, CVXPYgen, mongoose-delete) and internal CI/CD workflow utilities — no published API spec, SDK package, or developer documentation.

providers.name: CADDi
providers.description: CADDi is a Tokyo-headquartered manufacturing-technology company that builds an AI Data Platform for industrial manufacturers. Its two products, CADDi Drawer and CADDi Quote, aggregate scattered 2D engineering drawings and supply-chain data into a single searchable asset, offering keyword and drawing-similarity search, automatic extraction of dimensions, text and shapes, and AI-assisted quotation and sourcing. The platform serves procurement, engineering, sales, production, quality, and leadership teams across automotive, robotics, and precision-machinery sectors, and connects to ERP, CAM, CAD, and quality systems via batch and CSV imports. CADDi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Atomico and DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. It does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK.

providers.name: Rx Redefined
providers.description: Rx Redefined Inc is a healthcare technology company in Arroyo Grande, California, founded in 2018, that operates a patented, compliance-focused DMEPOS (durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics and supplies) platform for physicians. The platform lets a medical practice become a licensed physician-owned DMEPOS supplier and distribute medical supplies — insulin pumps, breast pumps, ostomy pouches, urinary catheters — directly to its own patients instead of handing the order to a third-party supplier. It ships two products: a Full-Service product built around physician personal performance, and an In-Office product built around the in-office ancillary services exception. The platform covers CMS licensing onboarding, electronic ordering with per-order compliance and eligibility checks, supply-chain integration with 10+ U.S. distribution centers, and end-to-end revenue-cycle and audit management. The company reports use across 350+ U.S. clinics and runs on ISO 27001 certified infrastructure with HIPAA controls. The product is a customer-only web application at app.rxredefined.com; Rx Redefined publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Sanmina
providers.description: Sanmina Corporation is a global contract manufacturer and leading provider of end-to-end design, manufacturing, logistics, and repair solutions for OEMs across defense, industrial, medical, communications, and computing markets. Through its 42Q subsidiary, Sanmina offers a cloud-based Manufacturing Execution System (MES) with APIs for integrating with ERP, PLM, WMS, and other enterprise systems. Sanmina's 42Q MES provides real-time factory visibility, traceability, quality management, and production control across globally distributed manufacturing facilities.

providers.name: 91Squarefeet
providers.description: 91Squarefeet is a Gurugram, India based design-and-build company delivering turnkey retail and office fit-outs for brands expanding their physical footprint across India. Founded 2018-2019 and backed by Y Combinator, Stellaris Venture Partners and Stride Ventures, it runs a full-stack, non-subcontracted model — in-house project management, a digitized supply chain spanning fixture factories, material OEMs, engineering consultants and labour contractors, and an internal AI-assisted project platform with a field mobile app — and reports 1,100+ delivered projects for brands including TATA, DLF, Godrej, Asian Paints, Kotak and Bluestone. It publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no OpenAPI. The only machine-readable surfaces on its host are the WordPress REST API its public website exposes (serving the company's own portfolio, client, case-study, property, testimonial and press-release content anonymously), a Rank Math llms.txt, and a gated WordPress MCP adapter endpoint.

providers.name: Arvist
providers.description: Arvist AI is a Chicago-based computer-vision platform for warehouse and supply-chain operations that turns existing cameras, scanners, and WMS/ERP data into automated quality control, safety and compliance monitoring, load verification, inbound shipment inspection, and freight-claims management. The system deploys on-premise edge servers, integrates with 80+ leading WMS and ERP platforms without new hardware, and detects damage, defects, unsafe behavior, and outbound shipping errors in real time. Backed by Techstars, Arvist is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type I compliant. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from Arvist's public web surface; the company currently publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Colgate-Palmolive
providers.description: Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer-products manufacturer operating in oral care, personal care, home care, and pet nutrition through brands such as Colgate, Palmolive, Hill's Pet Nutrition, Speed Stick, Ajax, and Softsoap. Colgate-Palmolive does not publish a general-purpose public developer REST API. Its B2B integration footprint is centered on EDI exchanges with retail trading partners (X12 messages, AS2, VAN), supplier integrations through SAP Ariba, and internal corporate systems. There is also a corporate sustainability and ESG reporting surface, but it is not exposed as a developer API.

providers.name: Kabal
providers.description: Kabal is the energy industry's leading logistics management SaaS platform. Founded in Norway in 2011 (formerly Wellit), Kabal provides an integrated, cloud-native platform that manages cargo, marine, transport, personnel, warehouse, rig and installation logistics across both offshore and onshore operations for oil & gas operators. The platform spans planning, execution and optimization, plus cost and emissions tracking and KPI reporting, connecting operators with their suppliers and vessels to share business-critical logistics data. Kabal is trusted by energy supermajors including ExxonMobil, Shell, Chevron, BP, TotalEnergies, Equinor, Petronas, Repsol, Eni and ADNOC, with tens of thousands of users across dozens of countries. Kabal received a growth investment from Insight Partners in 2023.

providers.name: Lyric
providers.description: Lyric is an AI-powered supply chain software company, founded in 2022 and backed by Insight Partners. Its Lyric Studio platform lets enterprises model, plan, and optimize their supply chains across four composable layers — Data (enterprise-grade data management and integrations), Algorithms (advanced supply chain science), Workflows (flexible, composable processes), and Models & Apps (ready-to-use applications). The platform spans network modeling, transportation optimization, inventory management, forecasting, routing, and scheduling. Lyric does not publish a public developer API surface; its product documentation at docs.lyric.tech is gated behind a Lyric Studio login. It does operate a public SafeBase security and trust portal documenting SOC 2, SOC 3, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, and CSA STAR Level 1 posture plus a responsible disclosure program.

providers.name: Ranger AI
providers.description: Ranger AI, operating as Ranger RFX Inc., provides an AI‑powered intelligence layer for industrial engineering. It helps organizations automate RFP responses, evaluate tenders, and review contracts by extracting answers from technical documents and citing sources. The platform targets procurement automation, engineering document analysis, and enterprise AI applications, delivering accurate, citation‑backed insights to streamline decision‑making in industrial contexts.

providers.name: Mercanto
providers.description: Mercanto (mercanto.mx) is a Mexican B2B wholesale marketplace that supplies restaurants, cafeterias, and food-service businesses with ingredients, groceries, cleaning supplies, and packaging bought at wholesale from vetted suppliers, with negotiated pricing and next-day delivery. Buyers order across categories including produce, groceries and pantry, dairy and eggs, proteins and cold cuts, bakery and desserts, beverages, frozen foods, and non-food items, while Mercanto handles supplier selection, negotiation, and fulfillment. The company is backed by Bain Capital Ventures. Its customer-facing storefront runs on a private backend (api.mercanto.mx) that is not publicly documented for third-party developers, so there is no public API product, developer portal, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Mondial Relay
providers.description: Mondial Relay provides parcel delivery and locker services across Europe, operating a dense network of over 12,000 lockers and 94,500 pickup points. It offers e‑livraison solutions for both consumers and e‑commerce merchants, enabling flexible parcel sending, tracking, and collection through its web portal and mobile apps. The company focuses on reliable, simple, and convenient logistics for shipments within France and across European markets.

providers.name: Ninja Van
providers.description: Ninja Van is a Southeast Asian last-mile logistics and parcel-delivery company operating across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, and Thailand. Its ninjaAPI lets merchants and e-commerce platforms integrate shipping programmatically - create and cancel delivery orders, generate waybills (AWB), estimate tariffs, look up Ninja Point (PUDO) drop-off locations, receive parcel status updates via webhooks, and pull tracking events. The API is country-scoped (the country code is part of the path, e.g. https://api.ninjavan.co/SG/...) and authenticated with OAuth2 client credentials; access is granted per merchant after an onboarding and integration audit.

providers.name: Nowports
providers.description: Nowports is a digital freight forwarder for Latin America, offering technology-enabled international logistics across ocean, air, and ground freight. Its Centraliza platform centralizes shipment tracking, document management, and alerts, while adjacent services cover cargo insurance and GPS tracking (Protege) and inventory financing and factoring (Financia). Backed by Partech and Y Combinator, Nowports serves importers and exporters on major trade routes through its authenticated web app at app.nowports.com. As of this profile Nowports exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; access is via its authenticated web platform.

providers.name: Vallor
providers.description: Vallor (Board AI, Inc.) is an AI coworker for procurement, legal, and sales teams that puts contracts on autopilot. Val reads every contract across the existing stack, drafts redlines against a playbook, flags risks, monitors obligations, renewals, SLAs, and rebates against live ERP and AP data, and answers plain-English questions with citations back to the source clause. It connects to 1,000+ systems including SAP, NetSuite, Snowflake, Salesforce, Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign, and Slack, and ships a first-party Claude Code / Cowork plugin marketplace with 32 agent skills and 9 background agents for contract management and strategic sourcing. SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR compliant, with customer data staying in the customer tenant. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Aumet
providers.description: Aumet is a MENA-based healthtech company building an AI-first procurement and pharmacy operating system for healthcare. Its platform connects pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, and pharmacies through a B2B marketplace and a suite of pharmacy software: Pulse (point-of-sale, inventory, and smart reordering for individual pharmacies), Chain (multi-branch pharmacy management), and Enterprise (solutions for government health systems and hospitals). The platform adds AI-powered demand forecasting, procurement automation, price transparency, and analytics, and reports serving 12,000+ pharmacies and 1,000+ suppliers across Jordan, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia with over $1B in gross merchandise value and millions of transactions annually. Aumet is backed by 500 Global and Techstars.

providers.name: Boxbee
providers.description: Boxbee is an on-demand storage and reusable moving-box rental service operating across California, including the San Francisco Bay Area, San Jose, Oakland, Los Angeles, Orange County, the Inland Empire, and San Diego. It offers valet pickup-and-delivery storage, rentable reusable plastic moving crates for consumers and businesses, and an online inventory system for managing stored items. Boxbee originated as a 500 Startups and Google Ventures-backed app-based valet self-storage startup founded in 2012; after the by-the-box operation was sold, the brand continued as a regional storage and moving-supply provider. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: CHAMP Cargosystems
providers.description: Champ.aero, also known as CHAMP Cargosystems, is a company that provides comprehensive IT solutions for the air cargo industry, offering a range of software applications and services to manage all aspects of air cargo operations, including booking, handling, accounting, customs clearance, and messaging, primarily through their flagship product called "Cargospot.".

providers.name: CloudTrucks
providers.description: CloudTrucks (operated by Cloud Technologies, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based virtual trucking carrier and business-management platform for owner-operators and small trucking fleets. The platform aggregates freight loads from more than fifty brokers and shippers into a single app, and layers on load booking, dispatching, real-time tracking, instant pay on proof of delivery, invoicing, factoring, fuel discounts (FuelApp), insurance, and back-office financial tooling so independent drivers can run their business from a phone. CloudTrucks also operates Exchange for shippers and brokers plus a freight-agent program, and is backed by Craft Ventures, Kindred Ventures and Menlo Ventures. CloudTrucks does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, support and mobile-app surface plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Food Market Hub
providers.description: Food Market Hub is a cloud-based procurement, inventory, and supply-chain management platform for food-and-beverage businesses, founded in Malaysia and headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. It automates back-end operations for restaurants, cafes, and central kitchens — connecting F&B outlets with their suppliers and central kitchens to handle purchase-order creation, smart ordering, inventory tracking, food-cost and wastage control, supplier management, and real-time reporting. The platform serves brands such as KFC, Pizza Hut, Salad Atelier, and Kenny Hills alongside thousands of independent restaurants across Southeast Asia (Malaysia, Indonesia, and China), and is delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Food Market Hub is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; integrations (including POS sales-data connections) are handled directly by the company.

providers.name: OnTrac
providers.description: OnTrac provides last‑mile delivery services for e‑commerce parcels across the western United States, offering ground, express, and specialized logistics solutions. Their platform integrates with major marketplaces and shipping software, enabling businesses to ship quickly and track packages in real time. OnTrac emphasizes reliability, speed, and customer support for both residential and commercial deliveries.

providers.name: Panjiva
providers.description: Panjiva is a supply chain intelligence platform owned by S&P Global Market Intelligence that delivers data-driven insights for the global trade community. It combines global import/export shipment records with machine learning analytics to profile companies, map supply chains, benchmark competitors, surface sales leads, and assess counterparty and supply-chain risk. Panjiva covers roughly 9 million companies and more than 2 billion shipment records spanning an estimated 35% of global trade flows. Trade data is also delivered programmatically to CRM systems, quantitative models, and research workflows through S&P Global's XpressFeed data-feed service and is surfaced inside S&P Capital IQ Pro. Access is enterprise and subscription based; Panjiva does not publish a public self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Resourcify
providers.description: Resourcify (Resourcify GmbH) is a Hamburg, Germany based digital platform for waste management and circular-economy operations, describing itself as "the operating system for a circular future." Its cloud software helps enterprises digitize and optimize their waste streams end to end - automating waste and recycling operations, optimizing cost, CO2 and recycling rates, tracking compliance, and running take-back systems - across manufacturing, construction, retail, healthcare, and airports. The platform connects waste producers with a network of recyclers and haulers, captures waste data and documentation, and reports on sustainability and material recovery. Resourcify is backed by Speedinvest. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; integrations are delivered as managed connections rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Rinse
providers.description: Rinse is a laundry and dry cleaning delivery service that picks up customers' clothes from home, professionally cleans them, and returns them on a recurring or one-off schedule. It runs a wash & fold and dry cleaning model in which uniformed valets handle evening pickup and delivery (typically 7pm-10pm) across major U.S. metros including the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Washington D.C., Boston, Seattle, and Austin, plus Toronto. Rinse emphasizes convenience, garment care, sustainability, and employing its valets as W-2 employees with benefits. The company is backed by Partech and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Rinse publishes a consumer web and mobile product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Skootar
providers.description: Skootar is a Thai on-demand courier, messenger, and logistics platform serving Bangkok, its surrounding provinces, and Chonburi. It offers same-day document delivery, cheque and bill collection, parcel shipping, business food delivery, and on-demand pickup-truck and moving jobs across a fleet of motorcycles, cars, and trucks, all with real-time tracking. Orders can be placed 24/7 through the website, the mobile app, or an API intended for high-volume businesses to wire delivery ordering into their own back-office systems. Skootar reports more than 130,000 business customers, 26,000+ drivers, and 9.2 million+ completed deliveries over 12 years, and is backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK is published; API access is arranged through its business/enterprise channel.

providers.name: Souco
providers.description: Souco (株式会社souco / souco Co., Ltd.) operates a warehouse-sharing marketplace and logistics resource optimization platform in Japan, connecting cargo owners with available space across a nationwide network of 3,000+ warehouses spanning all 47 prefectures. Businesses can secure short- or long-term storage on demand for a wide range of cargo — food ingredients, apparel, machinery, and documents — under ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or temperature-controlled conditions, with pickup and delivery coordination handled by the platform. Alongside the sharing marketplace, souco offers a rental-warehouse search portal, transportation services, and the Optis engine for optimizing logistics networks, plus consulting and DX support for the logistics industry. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sumitomo Corporation's corporate venture arm. souco is a customer-facing logistics platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; its digital surface is a login-gated web application at app.souco.space.

providers.name: Trendsi
providers.description: Trendsi is a wholesale clothing supplier and dropshipping platform for online fashion retailers, boutiques, and social-commerce creators. Delivered primarily as a Shopify app and a TikTok Shop integration, Trendsi lets sellers source trendy apparel — dresses, tops, and activewear — and offer dropshipping, open-pack wholesale, private labeling, and made-to-order fulfillment with no upfront inventory. The platform handles sourcing, warehousing, packing, and shipping under the retailer's own brand, with competitive wholesale pricing and fast US shipping. Sellers manage their catalog, orders, and fulfillment from the Trendsi seller portal at app.trendsi.com. Trendsi does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration with a merchant's store is delivered through its Shopify and TikTok Shop apps.

providers.name: Ascend Elements
providers.description: Ascend Elements is a Westborough, Massachusetts battery materials company that manufactures engineered lithium-ion battery materials from valuable elements reclaimed from spent lithium-ion batteries and gigafactory manufacturing scrap. Founded in 2015 as Battery Resourcers out of MIT-affiliated research by Eric Gratz and Professor Yan Wang, it recovers up to 98% of the critical battery metals in end-of-life cells and uses its patented Hydro-to-Cathode direct cathode precursor (pCAM) synthesis process to produce cathode precursor and battery-grade lithium carbonate, reducing the carbon footprint of new EV battery cathode material by up to 90%. Its Base 1 facility in Covington, Georgia is North America's largest electric-vehicle battery recycling plant, and Apex 1 in Hopkinsville, Kentucky is its commercial pCAM plant. Ascend Elements publishes no public developer API for its materials, recycling or logistics business; the only machine-readable surface observed on its own hosts is the WordPress REST API at ascendelements.com/wp-json, which serves the corporate website's content, media-coverage, jobs and supplier sourcing-event collections.

providers.name: Route
providers.description: Route is a post-purchase platform for e-commerce brands that helps merchants own the customer experience after checkout. Its core products are package protection (shipping insurance covering lost, stolen, or damaged orders), AI-driven returns that reduce refunds and returns fraud, and real-time order and package tracking for shoppers. Route serves both merchants and their customers through storefront widgets, a mobile app, and a developer API documented on Stoplight. The company is backed by Craft Ventures.

providers.name: Approve.com
providers.description: Approve.com is a cloud-based procurement platform founded in 2019 in Israel that lets businesses stand up a proper purchase-order process quickly, streamlining purchase requisitions, multi-step approvals, real-time budgets, and vendor onboarding with real-time spend controls and insights. Tipalti acquired Approve.com in April 2021 and now operates it as Tipalti Procurement (Tipalti Approve). Its Procurement REST API is still served from the approve.com domain (production https://triggers.approve.com, sandbox https://triggers.sandbox.approve.com), authenticating with an x-api-key header and exchanging JSON with ISO 8601 dates; the purchase-orders API exposes GET and Update purchase-order operations so an external system can stay in sync with Tipalti.

providers.name: AtoB
providers.description: AtoB is a fleet payments platform for the trucking and transportation industry, offering fuel cards, spend-management controls, driver payouts, and trip credit to fleets of every size. Its cards work across a nationwide fuel network with truck-stop discounts, granular purchase controls (fuel-only, category/MCC restrictions, per-transaction and daily limits), telematics-aware fraud prevention, and reporting that supports IFTA fuel-tax and expense compliance. AtoB also runs partner programs for factoring companies, freight brokers, and merchants, and exposes a private Partners API used by telematics and fleet-management integrations (for example Fleetio and Oxmaint) to sync cards, drivers, vehicles, and settled fuel transactions. AtoB was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and General Catalyst; this profile has been enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: Barn2Door
providers.description: Barn2Door is a Seattle-based commerce and business-management platform purpose-built for independent farmers and local food producers. It gives farms an online store, order and subscription management, inventory tracking, delivery and pickup logistics, integrated payments, and built-in marketing and customer-relationship tools, consolidating the systems a farm needs to sell direct-to-consumer and wholesale into a single dashboard. Barn2Door connects to partners including Mailchimp, QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Avalara, Shippo, Routific, Squarespace, and Facebook, but does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal at this time.

providers.name: Goodr
providers.description: Goodr is an Atlanta-based sustainable surplus food management and hunger-relief logistics company founded in 2016 by Jasmine Crowe-Houston. Goodr helps businesses divert edible and inedible food waste from landfills by scheduling pickups, donating surplus edible food to local nonprofits, and providing donors with the tax deductions and impact reporting tied to those donations. Alongside its food-waste solutions, Goodr runs hunger-relief programs including pop-up grocery markets, meal delivery, student snackpacks, and community grocery stores. The company reports more than 30 million meals served and 4 million pounds of food diverted from landfills for enterprise partners such as Amazon, Google, NASA, and Fulton County. Goodr operates through a partner portal rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jala
providers.description: JALA is an Indonesian aquaculture technology company providing end-to-end solutions for the shrimp farming industry, describing itself as a fully connected system powered by data farmers can trust. It connects farmers, processors, and buyers through the JALA App for real-time pond monitoring and data analytics, the Baruni technology platform, farming supplies (post-larvae, feed, technical assistance), harvest and cold-chain logistics services, and traceable certified supply chains for processors and buyers. Backed by 500 Global, JALA operates a consumer/operator SaaS platform (app.jala.tech) rather than a public developer API program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Faks
providers.description: Faks is a French SaaS platform that digitizes and streamlines the commercial relationships across the pharmacy ecosystem. It gives pharmacies, pharmacy groups (groupements), and laboratories a single place to manage supplier relationships, commercial claims and disputes (litiges), expired and returnable product handling, promotions, and sell-in / sell-out performance. Faks connects to pharmacy management systems (LGO), purchasing platforms, and accounting tools through its Konnect integrations to automate what has traditionally been manual, paper, and email-driven work between the ~18,000 pharmacies, ~100 groups, and ~500 laboratories it targets in France. The company is backed by Seedcamp. Faks does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the enrichment surfaces that could be probed.

providers.name: NoScrubs
providers.description: NoScrubs (NoScrubs, Inc., dba NoScrubs Laundry Delivery) is an on-demand wash-and-fold laundry pickup and delivery service operating across US metros including the Bay Area, Los Angeles, Dallas-Fort Worth, Miami, Phoenix, Austin, and Houston. Customers schedule a pickup through the NoScrubs mobile app or website; trained laundry professionals ("Scrubbers") collect laundry from the doorstep within a two-hour window, professionally wash, dry, and fold it using hypoallergenic unscented detergents, and return it the same day in as little as four hours. NoScrubs also offers monthly subscription plans, gift cards, and a wash-and-fold service for businesses. It is a consumer service company with no public developer API; the site publishes an llms.txt for AI agents.

providers.name: Gooten
providers.description: Gooten is a print-on-demand and global manufacturing and fulfillment platform for custom products - apparel, wall art, drinkware, home goods, and more. Its REST API (hosted at api.print.io, the platform Gooten was built on) lets ecommerce brands and developers browse the product catalog and per-region SKUs, retrieve print templates, create print-ready products from artwork, quote shipping and order prices, and submit and manage manufacturing orders routed across Gooten's distributed vendor network. Requests are authenticated with a public RecipeID and, for order and billing operations, a private PartnerBillingKey. There are no setup or monthly fees - you pay the per-order production and shipping cost only when an item is manufactured and shipped.

providers.name: Joor
providers.description: JOOR is a New York-based SaaS company (founded 2010) operating a leading B2B wholesale fashion commerce platform and digital marketplace that connects fashion brands with retailers to run their wholesale business end to end. The platform digitizes wholesale buying with online linesheets, lookbooks, virtual showrooms, order management, and the JOOR Marketplace, alongside products such as JOOR Pay (wholesale payments), JOOR Passport (virtual trade shows), and Retail data/analytics. JOOR connects thousands of brands with hundreds of thousands of retail doors globally. Its production platform is fronted by a Kong API gateway and secured with Keycloak-based OpenID Connect authentication; API access is partner/integration-oriented rather than a self-serve public developer program. This profile was enriched from JOOR's live public surface (OIDC discovery, GitHub organization, and status page).

providers.name: Clutter
providers.description: Clutter is a full-service, on-demand storage and moving company (clutter.com) that picks up, professionally packs and photo-catalogs customers' belongings, stores them in secure 24/7-monitored warehouses, and redelivers individual items on demand. Founded in 2013 and once a SoftBank-backed unicorn, Clutter merged with MakeSpace and was acquired by Iron Mountain in 2023; it now operates as "Clutter by Iron Mountain" serving major US metros and Toronto. This is a consumer-facing services company with a customer account portal and booking flow but no public developer program or API; the record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: Govini
providers.description: Govini (rebranded to Air, air.ai, in 2026) is a defense-technology and decision-analytics company whose Ark platform combines proprietary defense acquisition data with AI-enabled applications to close the national-security "Readiness Gap" across supply chain, science and technology, production, sustainment, logistics, and modernization missions. Ark holds FedRAMP High authorization and a DISA Impact Level 5 (IL5) Provisional Authorization plus service-level IL5 ATOs, making it a closed, government-authorized SaaS platform rather than a public developer API. Led by CEO Tara Murphy Dougherty and backed by investors including Accel and Bain Capital. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and has been enriched with the provider's real public identity, security posture, and published compliance authorizations.

providers.name: iTradeNetwork
providers.description: iTradeNetwork is a perishables supply chain management company serving the food and beverage industry. Per its website it offers end-to-end solutions for procurement, quality, traceability and spend management, including an Order Management System (OMS), EDI connectivity, FSMA 204 traceability, spend insights, MarginIQ trade reconciliation, freight and transportation management, master data services, and the Cerena network for distributors, operators, manufacturers, retail grocers and grower-shippers.

providers.name: Medvelle AI
providers.description: Medvelle AI provides AI‑powered inventory management and procurement solutions for aesthetic and spa clinics. Their platform automates ordering, compares suppliers, forecasts demand, and offers finance, analytics, and supplier management tools, helping clinics save time and reduce costs while focusing on patient care. The company emphasizes a proprietary procurement process and AI-driven insights to maximize profit for healthcare providers.

providers.name: Partsimony
providers.description: Partsimony is an intelligent supply chain platform that helps hardware companies turn engineering designs into manufactured products with less time, cost, and friction. Its software analyzes component designs to recommend manufacturing methods, materials, price estimates, and lead times, then matches each part to the optimal manufacturers inside and outside a company's network — batching components for volume leverage across processes like 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, castings, electronics, and assemblies. The platform also coordinates RFPs, proposals, orders, messaging, and payment terms between OEMs and their manufacturing partners. Partsimony operates a web application and product documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and based in Brooklyn, NY; backed by Techstars.

providers.name: SmartHop
providers.description: SmartHop is a fleet and trip management platform for small trucking companies, owner-operators, and independent dispatchers. It aggregates real-time loads from multiple freight sources into a single load board and provides load booking, trip creation and management, dispatch management, payroll, profit optimization, market analysis, and performance reporting. SmartHop consumes third-party freight APIs from partners including DAT Freight & Analytics, C.H. Robinson, Loadsmart, Redwood Logistics, Newtrul, and Parade, but does not publish a public developer API of its own; its api.smarthop.co host backs the SmartHop web and mobile apps rather than a documented external API.

providers.name: TrueCommerce
providers.description: TrueCommerce provides end‑to‑end supply‑chain solutions, including EDI, e‑invoicing, VMI, and B2B eCommerce platforms. Their services connect trading partners, automate order management, and ensure compliance with global invoicing standards, helping manufacturers, retailers, and distributors streamline operations.

providers.name: Applied Ev
providers.description: Applied EV is a Melbourne‑based mobility technology company developing autonomous electric freight and industrial vehicles. It offers a software‑defined platform with a proprietary Digital Backbone control system, enabling scalable autonomy for logistics, warehouse, and factory transport. The company provides hardware such as the Blanc Robot cabin‑less vehicle and a suite of power and control products, and partners with firms like Siemens, NXP, and Oxbotica to deliver end‑to‑end autonomous solutions.

providers.name: Austrian Post (Post AG)
providers.description: Austrian Post (Post AG) is Austria’s national postal service provider, offering a wide range of mail, parcel, logistics, and digital services. The company operates an extensive network of post offices and delivery infrastructure, supporting both domestic and international shipments. Its online platform provides rate calculators, tracking, e‑letter services, and business solutions such as bulk mailing and e‑commerce fulfillment. The website also hosts corporate information, investor relations, sustainability initiatives, and a blog with updates on services and innovations.

providers.name: Medzoomer
providers.description: Medzoomer is an on-demand prescription delivery platform that connects pharmacies, healthcare providers, and patients through a secure, HIPAA-compliant network of verified couriers. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Tampa, Florida, the company handles last-mile medication logistics, including controlled substances (Schedule II-V), with tamper-evident packaging, FDA/TSA-approved envelopes, and real-time order tracking. Pharmacies and couriers operate through dedicated web and mobile applications, and the platform is backed by Techstars, UnitedHealthcare Accelerator, and other investors. Medzoomer operates a private pharmacy integration API but publishes no public developer documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Ordana
providers.description: Ordana provides AI agents that run wholesale order-desk operations for distributors, reading every order across email, fax, PDF, EDI, voice, SMS and chat, resolving exceptions, communicating with retailers, and closing orders directly into the customer's ERP. Four agents cover the surface: Desk (end-to-end order automation), Voice (inbound/outbound phone ordering), Predict (cart prediction and AOV optimization), and Chat (text/SMS ordering). Ordana sits as an intelligence layer on top of existing ERP and commerce systems via pre-built connectors, and exposes its capabilities through a gated REST API, Webhooks, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over HTTP/SSE with OAuth 2.0, and the A2A agent-to-agent protocol. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Backpack
providers.description: Backpack is an e‑commerce fulfillment service that enables shoppers in Bangladesh to purchase products from Amazon, eBay and other US/UK stores, delivering them within 16 days with a world‑class shopper guarantee and policy support.

providers.name: Minoan
providers.description: Minoan is a hospitality procurement and shoppable-stays platform. Short-term-rental hosts, property managers, hotels, and interior designers source furniture, decor, and home goods at insider/trade pricing through Minoan's purchasing platform, and earn revenue share when guests buy the items they experienced during a stay. Founded to turn every hosted space into a shoppable showroom, Minoan connects properties to hundreds of home-and-lifestyle brands and handles sourcing, checkout, and fulfillment. Backed by Accel. As of this profile Minoan exposes no public developer API; this record captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Spoiler Alert
providers.description: Spoiler Alert is a Boston-based software company (a Techstars portfolio company) that helps consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers manage and sell excess, short-dated, and obsolete inventory. Its purpose-built platform digitizes discounting and liquidation processes, matching surplus inventory with the right buyers at the right price through a secondary marketplace, with automated listing generation, dynamic pricing optimization, freight cost management, and performance analytics to recover margin and reduce food and product waste. The platform is delivered as a closed SaaS application (app.spoileralert.com); no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: SVT Robotics
providers.description: SVT Robotics builds the SOFTBOT Platform, a software integration and orchestration foundation for warehouse automation and the supply chain. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, the company lets enterprises connect industrial systems, robotics, AMRs, and warehouse management software through standardized, prebuilt SOFTBOT Connectors — reducing integration complexity and enabling real-time visibility, faster automation deployments, and a resilient data backbone for automation and AI. Customers include DHL Supply Chain, Barrett Distribution Centers, and the Hagen Group. The provider operates a developer documentation hub for the SOFTBOT integration API (docs.svtrobotics.com, currently password-protected) and a public status page; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or open API surface was discoverable at enrichment time.

providers.name: BeyondTrucks
providers.description: BeyondTrucks provides AI‑powered transportation management software for mission‑critical fleets. Their platform automates order ingestion, dispatch planning, finance, and analytics, leveraging generative AI to create dynamic rate logic and real‑time optimization. Serving industries from petroleum to food‑and‑beverage, BeyondTrucks helps fleets reduce manual errors, improve utilization, and accelerate order processing with intelligent automation and predictive notifications.

providers.name: Emirates SkyCargo
providers.description: Emirates SkyCargo is the air cargo division of Emirates Airline, headquartered at Dubai International Airport in the United Arab Emirates, moving general freight, pharmaceuticals, perishables, live animals, valuables, mail and courier traffic across a network of more than 140 destinations on six continents using both freighters and passenger-aircraft bellyhold capacity. In the shipment chain it is the airborne carrier leg sitting between the freight forwarder and the ground handler, and it books almost exclusively through intermediaries rather than shippers directly. Its API posture is advertised but not published: Emirates SkyCargo states on its own Digital Booking Channels page that it offers "a direct API connection to your in-house system" covering booking creation, amendments, cancellations and track and trace, yet there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document, no base URL and no self-serve signup anywhere on skycargo.com. Access is obtained only by emailing SkyCargoAPISupport@emirates.com to negotiate a host-to-host connection, by integrating through the CargoWise transport management system, by submitting Freight Forwarding Requests over EDI, or by booking through the WebCargo, CargoAi, Pelicargo and cargo.one marketplaces, which themselves require IATA/CASS accreditation. The one standard the organization documents on its own surface is IATA e-AWB: agents must sign the IATA Multilateral e-AWB Agreement before submitting FWB and FHL cargo messages over EDI messaging. This is an EDI-and-bilateral-integration carrier with a customer-contract portal veneer, not a public API provider.

providers.name: OrderCircle
providers.description: OrderCircle is a B2B wholesale order management software platform, founded in 2015 in San Francisco, that gives fast-growing brands one system to automate wholesale orders, track inventory in real time, generate invoices, and run a self-service B2B eCommerce portal for their buyers. It targets wholesale operations in apparel, coffee, jewelry, food and beverage, hemp, vape, and CBD, and connects to existing tools through pre-built integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, QuickBooks, Xero, ShipStation, Stripe, Square, PayPal PayFlow, and Authorize.Net. OrderCircle does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its programmatic surface is limited to its packaged third-party integrations. This profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Vector.ai
providers.description: Vector.ai, now operating as Raft (raft.ai), is an AI-powered logistics automation platform for freight forwarders, customs brokers, and trade finance teams. The Raft Intelligence Engine layers organization data, contextual LLMs, orchestration, and specialized governed agents to automate document processing, invoice matching, data extraction, and exception handling across supply chain operations, reporting 20M+ tasks completed by AI agents and 5M+ shipments processed annually. Raft publishes no public developer API; the platform is an enterprise application that integrates with customers' TMS and ERP systems.

providers.name: Cargobeamer
providers.description: CargoBeamer provides a smart, reliable and environmentally friendly system for intermodal transport of semi‑trailers by rail across Europe. It connects logistics companies, freight forwarders and shippers with a growing network of routes and terminals, aiming to reduce road congestion and emissions while offering flexible, fast rail‑based freight solutions.

providers.name: EXIGER
providers.description: Exiger is an AI-native supply chain, third-party, and software supply chain risk and compliance company. Its 1Exiger platform unifies supplier, product, part, component, and risk data into a single system to help organizations map and orchestrate compliant, resilient physical and software supply chains. Product areas span supply chain visibility and optimization, trade and third-party risk and compliance, due diligence intelligence (DDIQ), and software supply chain security (SBOM analysis, from its Ion Channel acquisition). Exiger serves government and commercial customers and is FedRAMP authorized. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched from Exiger's public corporate, trust, and legal surfaces; Exiger does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Premier Inc
providers.description: Premier Inc (NASDAQ: PINC) is a US healthcare improvement company that operates one of the largest group purchasing organizations and the PINC AI technology and services platform for clinical intelligence, margin improvement and value-based care, built on cost, quality and operational data from US hospital discharges. It publishes no public developer program.

providers.name: Mienvío
providers.description: Mienvío is a Mexican logistics control-tower platform that unifies multiple parcel carriers behind a single multi-carrier shipping API and dashboard for e-commerce, retail, marketplace, and fintech shippers across Latin America. It compares carrier rates, automates routing by cost, SLA, and coverage zone, generates shipping labels, and provides real-time tracking, delivery-incident management, and post-purchase customer notifications. Merchants integrate through the REST API (api.mienvio.mx/v2) or prebuilt Shopify and WooCommerce connectors, shipping nationally, internationally, and locally across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Guatemala, and El Salvador.

providers.name: Odeko
providers.description: Odeko is a cafe operations platform that keeps independent coffee shops and cafes stocked by combining predictive ordering, overnight supply delivery, and mobile ordering plus rewards management through a single dashboard. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network. Odeko publishes no first-party developer API; its public odeko.com storefront runs on Shopify, which provisions agentic-commerce surfaces (llms.txt, UCP profile, and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint) on the domain. This profile captures those real domain artifacts.

providers.name: TemperPack
providers.description: TemperPack is a Richmond, Virginia based sustainable packaging manufacturer, founded in 2015 and a Certified B Corporation, that designs and manufactures curbside recyclable and compostable alternatives to expanded polystyrene (EPS) and single-use plastic for cold chain and protective shipping. Its three material platforms are ClimaCell, a starch-and-paper thermal liner for cold chain shipments; Green Cell Foam, a certified compostable starch-based insulation with EPS-level performance; and WaveKraft, paper-based cushioning produced on demand. Products span cushioning, mailers, qualified shippers and stock shippers, serving life sciences, food and beverage, pet and veterinary, wine, and packaging distribution customers from ISO 9001:2015 certified plants in Richmond VA, Lansing MI and Las Vegas NV, with in-house ISTA thermal and mechanical testing at its Proving Ground lab. TemperPack operates a customer portal for order tracking, thermal testing results, billing and WaveKraft analytics, and an e-commerce store, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition or developer portal as of August 2026.

providers.name: Benchmark Electronics
providers.description: Benchmark Electronics, Inc. is an advanced electronics engineering and manufacturing services (EMS) company headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. The company provides integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing services from prototypes to high-volume production, including procurement, logistics, and repair. Benchmark serves original equipment manufacturers in defense, medical technologies, commercial aerospace, industrial, next-gen communications, advanced computing, and semiconductor capital equipment markets. The company operates approximately 22 locations in 8 countries with around 13,000 employees.

providers.name: Flytrex
providers.description: Flytrex is an autonomous drone delivery operator headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, with US operations centered on the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex and North Carolina. The company runs an end-to-end backyard delivery service that flies food and small goods from partner restaurants and retailers to consumer homes in roughly five minutes, operating its own Sky-series multirotor aircraft, ground docks, and a remote-operations control center. Flytrex sells to consumers through its own iOS and Android ordering apps and to merchants through a partner portal, and routes demand from third-party marketplaces including DoorDash and Uber Eats. It does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Lazada
providers.description: Lazada Group is a Southeast Asian e-commerce platform owned by Alibaba Group since 2016, operating localized marketplaces in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, and Vietnam. Lazada Open Platform (openapi.lazada.com) provides a partner-facing REST API for sellers, brands, ERP / OMS vendors, and TP (TaoBao Partner) developers — covering Product / Category catalog, Order processing, Logistics and shipping label generation, Finance and payout reconciliation, Shop and Seller profile, Promotion management (vouchers, FlexiCombo, Sponsored Solutions), Image / asset upload, Returns and reverse logistics, and Bidirectional message webhooks. Authentication uses an App Key + App Secret plus a per-seller access token issued via OAuth-style seller authorization, with all requests signed using HMAC-SHA256 in Alibaba's TOP signature scheme.

providers.name: Office Luv
providers.description: OfficeLuv is office management and purchasing software that centralizes all of a workplace's ordering into a single platform. It aggregates dozens of vendors and thousands of products (supplies, snacks, cleaning supplies, groceries, and more) into one unified marketplace with consolidated invoicing, spend analytics and reporting, multi-user approval workflows, employee stipends for remote and in-office staff, and optional on-site service for program design, pricing negotiation, and restocking. Customers include Wayfair, Braze, Glassdoor, Hulu, and Upwork. Office Luv was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The product is delivered as a private SaaS web application (app.officeluv.com); no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time.

providers.name: The Trade Lab
providers.description: The Trade Lab provides an AI‑assisted platform for international trade compliance, offering tools such as HTS lookup, duty calculation, tariff‑engineering analysis, customs document generation, and trade intelligence. Users can classify products, estimate landed costs across multiple markets, and access AI‑driven customs research, all within a unified workspace designed for importers, exporters, and compliance teams.

providers.name: Cogoport
providers.description: Cogoport is a global logistics and supply chain platform offering freight booking, customs, trade finance, and supply chain visibility for businesses across ocean, air, and inland transport. It provides ocean (FCL and LCL) and air freight booking with real-time rate discovery, customs clearance and compliance support, trade finance including invoice financing and pay-later solutions, end-to-end shipment tracking, and logistics tools such as an HS Code Finder, container trackers, and shipping cost calculators. Cogoport is backed by Accel and headquartered in India, serving importers and exporters worldwide.

providers.name: Comstruct
providers.description: Comstruct is a Munich-based construction technology company that provides AI-powered agents to automate the procurement of construction materials. Its platform runs the full procurement workflow from the bill of materials (Leistungsverzeichnis) through supplier inquiry, offer comparison, contract negotiation, digital delivery notes, AI-based invoice verification, and sustainability reporting. Customers include HOCHTIEF, Implenia, Marti, and Leonhard Weiss. Comstruct is backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of enrichment the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network from its public web presence.

providers.name: Deep Rooted
providers.description: Deep Rooted.Co is a direct-to-consumer fresh produce brand operated by Clover Ventures Pvt. Ltd, a Bengaluru-based agritech company founded in 2018 that launched the Deep Rooted consumer brand in 2020. The company works with a network of small-scale farmers using greenhouse and hydroponic techniques within roughly 150km of Bengaluru and Hyderabad, providing agronomy support from seed to harvest and delivering fruits, vegetables, Indian staples and greens, exotic produce and an easy-cook range direct to households the morning after ordering. Deep Rooted is backed by Accel. It sells through a consumer web storefront and mobile apps; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification, so this profile captures company identity and web properties only.

providers.name: EAT Club
providers.description: EAT Club is a corporate meal-delivery platform founded in 2010 in Redwood City, California by Kevin Yang and Rodrigo Santibanez, built around the idea of a "virtual cafeteria" for offices with no on-site dining. Instead of tray-style catering, each employee picks an individually packaged meal from a rotating daily menu produced by EAT Club's own kitchens and restaurant partners, and every order for a building arrives in one synchronized delivery. The company markets the program as an employee lunch benefit and reports 21 million meals delivered to roughly 1,145 companies across nine cities. Compass Group USA acquired EAT Club in October 2020 and folded its ordering, production and delivery technology into Compass Digital Labs, where it now underpins workplace, education and healthcare dining accounts across the US and Canada. The consumer-facing product is a React ordering app served from www.eatclub.com; EAT Club publishes no developer program, no API reference, no SDK and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Fluor
providers.description: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) is a Fortune 500 engineering, procurement, construction and maintenance company headquartered in Irving, Texas. Fluor designs and builds capital projects and provides project-management services for energy, chemicals, life sciences, mining and metals, advanced technologies, infrastructure and government clients worldwide, and licenses its own process technologies such as Econamine FG Plus and Fluor Solvent. Fluor sells engineering and construction services rather than software: it operates no developer program, publishes no API reference, and serves no machine-readable API contract. Its business-to-business integration with suppliers runs inside SAP Ariba and Workday, whose contracts belong to those vendors. This is an independent API Evangelist profile of Fluor's public surface.

providers.name: Hyphen
providers.description: Hyphen provides automated restaurant solutions for the foodservice industry, offering its Makeline system and CulinaryOS to automate meal production and augment kitchen staff. The platform includes features such as order management, inventory monitoring and forecasting, labor and operations management, and menu and recipe development. It is aimed at restaurants and foodservice operators seeking to increase productivity, reduce waste, and handle peak demand.

providers.name: JSW One
providers.description: JSW One Platforms is the digital B2B arm of India's JSW Group, operating a full-stack e-commerce and services platform for the country's manufacturing and construction MSMEs. It runs four connected businesses on one technology stack: JSW One Commerce (jswonemsme.com), a multi-brand marketplace for TMT bars, mild/hot-rolled/cold-rolled and structural steel, coated steel, wire rods, cement and bitumen sourced from certified mills; JSW One Homes (jswonehomes.com), a turnkey home-construction service with digital project tracking across fifteen Indian cities; JSW One Finance, the NBFC arm providing digital credit lines, channel financing and invoice factoring to MSMEs and retailers; and private brands JSW One TMT and One Helix. The platform reported FY25 gross merchandise value of INR 12,567 crore across more than 84,000 registered MSMEs, and raised INR 575 crore in a 2025 round led by the State Bank of India. JSW One publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; its customer-facing surfaces are the web marketplace and the JSW One MSME mobile apps. It does publish a maintained llms.txt on both of its consumer properties, plus an explicit AI/LLM bot-access policy on JSW One Homes.

providers.name: OSARO
providers.description: OSARO is a San Francisco-based industrial AI company that builds machine-learning software for warehouse and fulfillment robotics. Its SightWorks perception platform and AutoModel learning system let industrial robot arms perceive, grasp and place highly variable goods without per-SKU pre-training, 3D object models or fixed programming, powering piece picking, robotic bagging, kitting and mixed-case depalletizing in production deployments across five countries. OSARO sells complete robotic work cells and licenses its perception software to robot makers and system integrators, wrapping deployments in its HyperCare support program. The company publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; integration with customer estates (WMS/WCS, conveyors, ASRS, AMRs) is delivered as a professional-services engagement through OSARO and its integrator partners rather than through a self-serve API.

providers.name: Produce Pay
providers.description: ProducePay is an agtech fintech platform for the global fresh-produce supply chain, giving growers, distributors, and buyers a combination of trade financing and operational tooling. Its offerings include Pre-Season Financing (working capital ahead of the growing season), Quick-Pay (converting produce shipments into immediate cash during peak season), Visibility (real-time shipment tracking, quality control, and data-driven insights), Sourcing (connecting buyers and sellers for long-term partnerships), and Predictable Commerce programs that bundle capital, visibility, and partnerships for year-round supply stability. The company operates a marketplace for its members but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Replenysh
providers.description: Replenysh is an enterprise circularity platform that runs circular supply chains for brands and recovery facilities. It routes, recovers, verifies, and optimizes material recovery flows across a network of 5,000+ partners, giving enterprises a single control layer for reverse logistics with audit-ready chain-of-custody, pricing, settlement, and compliance documentation. Customers include PepsiCo, Disney, Marriott, and Live Nation. Backed by Kindred Ventures and M13. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: TikTok Shop API
providers.description: TikTok Shop is TikTok's integrated e-commerce platform that lets sellers, creators, and partners list products, manage inventory and fulfillment, and sell directly within TikTok's live streams, short videos, and shop tabs. The TikTok Shop Open API (open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com) is a RESTful API that uses OAuth 2.0 authentication and enables developers to programmatically manage products, orders, fulfillment, returns, finance, promotions, and seller authorization across TikTok Shop's global marketplaces.

providers.name: VWR International (Avantor)
providers.description: VWR International, now part of Avantor, is a global distributor of laboratory supplies, chemicals, equipment, and services for the life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and research industries. With over 180 years of history, VWR serves more than one million customers in over 30 countries. The company operates as Avantor's distribution and procurement platform, providing laboratory consumables, reagents, instruments, and cold chain solutions. VWR/Avantor offers e-procurement integrations and eProcurement APIs to support laboratory supply chain automation for enterprise customers through EDI, OCI/PunchOut, and catalog integration.

providers.name: WestRock
providers.description: WestRock (now Smurfit Westrock following its 2024 merger with Smurfit Kappa) is one of the world's largest paper and packaging companies. The company provides differentiated paper and packaging solutions including corrugated containers, consumer packaging, displays, and specialty packaging. WestRock serves consumer and industrial markets with an integrated supply chain connecting mills, converting operations, and customers globally.

providers.name: Booster Fuels
providers.description: Booster (Booster Fuels, Inc.) is a mobile energy delivery company that brings gasoline, diesel, diesel exhaust fluid (DEF), and renewable fuel alternatives directly to vehicles, fleets, and on-site fuel tanks using a fleet of Smart Tankers, removing the need for drivers to visit gas stations. The company serves enterprise fleets and local businesses across the United States, pairing on-demand fueling with a proprietary technology platform (BoosterOS / the Fleet dashboard at fleet.trybooster.com) for real-time fleet management, fuel-usage reporting, invoicing automation, fraud prevention, and emissions reduction. Booster offers custom enterprise integrations (ERP, CRM, and telematics such as Geotab and Samsara) but does not publish a public developer API portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs. This profile is a company/lead entry in the API Evangelist network; no public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Expedock
providers.description: Expedock is a digital business process outsourcing (BPO) and document-automation company for the logistics and freight-forwarding industry. It pairs AI-powered document automation products (FCL/LCL accounts-payable automation, monthly statement automation, and commercial invoice and packing-list data entry) with tech-enabled remote teams supported by operations managers and QA specialists. Freight forwarders, 3PLs, and supply-chain operators use Expedock to digitize shipping documents, automate back-office workflows, and scale operations without scaling headcount. Customers include Maersk, Gebrueder Weiss, and large shippers such as Nike, Adidas, Coca-Cola, and Shell. Expedock is backed by Insight Partners. The company operates a Digital BPO offering and document-automation product suite; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Qube Holdings
providers.description: Qube Holdings is Australia's largest integrated provider of import and export logistics services, operating across Australia, New Zealand and South-East Asia with a workforce of around 10,000 employees. Its Operating Division comprises Qube Logistics and Qube Ports and Bulk, and it holds a 50 per cent interest in Patrick Terminals, Australia's leading container terminal operator. Formerly ASX-listed (Qube Holdings LTD), Qube is now a private company majority-owned by a Macquarie Asset Management-led consortium including UniSuper and Pontegadea. Customers interact through login-gated web portals (Services Portal, Gateway, Global Track & Trace); no public developer API documentation was found on its sites.

providers.name: JD.com (Jingdong)
providers.description: JD.com (Jingdong) is one of China's largest direct-sales e-commerce platforms, operating a vast first-party retail business and a third-party (POP) marketplace alongside JD Logistics (one of China's largest integrated logistics networks), JD Health, JD Industrials, JD Property, and JD Cloud. JD exposes two distinct developer platforms: JD Open Platform (open.jd.com) — also known as JOS (Jingdong Open Service) — which hosts the partner / ISV REST API for sellers and ERP / OMS vendors covering ware (product), order, promotion, after-sale, warehouse, finance, customer service, message, JD logistics, and B2B; and JD Cloud (jdcloud.com) — JD's public cloud with compute (Cloud Virtual Machine, GPU, bare metal, function compute), storage (object, block, file), network (VPC, CDN, load balancer), database (MySQL, TiDB, StarDB, Redis, MongoDB, ClickHouse), AI (JoyBuilder, JoyAgent, JoyCode, OCR, speech), and security services.

providers.name: Ontruck
providers.description: Ontruck is a Spanish road-freight technology platform that connects shippers (cargadores) with a network of professional carriers (transportistas) for full-truckload and less-than-truckload pallet, package, and parcel transport across Spain, France, and wider Europe.
