Shippers get instant AI-driven pricing, automated carrier assignment, real-time traceability, and digital documentation through service tiers (Economy, Flex, Express); carriers get access to freight loads with dynamic pricing and 24/7 support. Ontruck also packages its stack as "Ontruck AI Tech" — an AI pricing engine, AI routing engine, a predictive incident system, and a forecast/capacity planner — offered as transport-management software. The company operates a marketing and customer web surface plus an in-product shipper/carrier application; it publishes no public developer/API portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: The Coca-Cola Company
providers.description: The Coca-Cola Company is the world's largest non-alcoholic beverage company, owning and marketing more than 200 brands across sparkling soft drinks, water, hydration, sports, coffee, tea, juice, dairy, and plant-based drinks. The company sells its products in more than 200 countries through a bottling and distribution partner network. While Coca-Cola does not currently publish a broadly available public REST API, it is a heavy enterprise API consumer running an internal API program on MuleSoft that connects ERP, manufacturing, distribution, retail, marketing, and consumer engagement systems through a Center for Enablement (C4E) model. Historical Coca-Cola Enterprises (CCE) Product and Location APIs at developer.cokecce.com are no longer maintained as a public-facing developer program.

providers.name: Aurizon
providers.description: Aurizon (Aurizon Holdings Limited, ASX: AZJ, formerly QR National) describes itself as Australia's largest rail freight operator. Its own site says it moves more than 250 million tonnes of Australian commodities each year to domestic and international markets, across coal, bulk and containerised freight, and it also runs a rail network business. Customers and suppliers use web portals such as FreightOnline and Customer Online. Aurizon does not publish a public developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Cofeapp
providers.description: Cofeapp, operating under the brand COFE Technologies, provides an agentic platform combining Agentic Commerce and Agentic Procurement engines. The platform powers a super‑app used by millions, offering e‑commerce, ordering, payments, loyalty, data intelligence, and enterprise automation solutions across the MENA region. It serves both consumer and enterprise customers, enabling businesses to run their operations with AI‑driven agents and a unified data model.

providers.name: Gatekeeper
providers.description: Gatekeeper is a SaaS contract lifecycle management (CLM) and vendor management platform that helps procurement, legal, and finance teams capture, approve, store, and renew supplier contracts with workflow automation, e-signature, spend analytics, and risk monitoring. The Gatekeeper REST API exposes vendors, contracts, employees, custom data records, files, workflows, and events so customers can integrate Gatekeeper with ERP, HRIS, and finance systems. API access is per-tenant and authenticated with a tenant-specific API key.

providers.name: Rio Tinto
providers.description: Rio Tinto is a British-Australian multinational mining and metals corporation and one of the world's largest producers of iron ore, aluminum, copper, and diamonds. Rio Tinto does not publish a public developer API, but operates supplier portals (Supplier Master Data Management and a transactional platform) and a START traceability program. Its GitHub presence is limited to a small number of internal forks (ai-sentry, xpano).

providers.name: trimtabist-com
providers.description: Trimtabist provides a free, no‑login service that lets users submit customs entries they have already filed and instantly recompute duties line‑by‑line against the tariff schedule as it existed on the entry date and origin. The platform emphasizes privacy, processing files on its own server without sharing data, and aims to help importers verify duty calculations quickly and accurately.

providers.name: Icertis
providers.description: Icertis is an AI-native contract intelligence company that turns enterprise contracts into structured, actionable data and measurable business outcomes. Its Contract Intelligence (ICI) platform manages agreements across their full lifecycle — authoring, negotiation, execution, obligation management, and ongoing analytics — spanning sell-side, buy-side, and corporate contracts. The platform pairs a configurable contract data model with AI capabilities (the "Vera" AI assistant and agent-powered drafting, redlining, and negotiation) trained on millions of contracts. Icertis serves large enterprises across manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, technology, financial services, and the public sector, and integrates with ERP, CRM, CPQ, and procurement systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and Coupa. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Icertis' public web presence.

providers.name: Lavante
providers.description: Lavante was a SaaS supplier information management (SIM) and profit-recovery company built on its patented Lavante Connect platform. Its products — Lavante SIM, Lavante Recovery and Vendor File Cleanse — cleansed vendor master files, verified addresses and TINs, ran OFAC screening, onboarded suppliers onto the Lavante Supplier Network, and drove dispute resolution and recovery audit across the procure-to-pay (P2P) ecosystem for Fortune 1000 clients in hospitality, retail, entertainment, manufacturing and medical. Lavante was acquired by PRGX Global and its standalone site was retired; www.lavante.com now 302-redirects to www.prgx.com, where the supplier-facing capability lives on as PRGX Supplier Connect. Lavante never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs or API documentation — the Internet Archive holds no api/developer/docs/swagger paths for the domain.

providers.name: Ross Stores
providers.description: Ross Stores, Inc. (NASDAQ: ROST) is the largest off-price apparel and home fashion retailer in the United States, operating over 1,700 Ross Dress for Less and 320+ dd's DISCOUNTS stores across 43 states, the District of Columbia, and Guam. The company sources a broad assortment of in-season, name-brand merchandise at deep discounts (20-60% below department and specialty store prices) through opportunistic buying. Ross operates a highly efficient supply chain powered by AI-driven inventory management, distribution automation, and integrated supplier and partner technology platforms.

providers.name: Wholesail
providers.description: Wholesail is an all-in-one accounts receivable and B2B payments platform for food & beverage wholesalers, distributors, and service vendors. It helps vendors onboard customers, manage credit risk, automate collections, accept ACH and card payments, and drive autopay — all connected to the vendor's ERP or accounting system. Wholesail is a fintech company backed by Foundry Group. As of enrichment it publishes no public developer API; it integrates with ERP systems using their native API protocols, scheduled file exchange, and robotic process automation, and it partners with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, JP Morgan, and SVB for payment processing. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Agriful
providers.description: Agriful (Agriful Software Inc.) is a cloud ERP for the fresh produce industry, founded in 2022 by Patrick Crowley (CEO) and Deep Randhawa (CTO) and backed by Fractal Software and Reservoir Ventures. Its web platform runs sales and purchase order entry, live inventory control, lot-level traceability for FSMA and PTI compliance, produce-specific AR/AP accounting and grower settlements, and customizable reporting for produce brokers, marketers, packer-shippers, wholesalers and distributors. As of this profile Agriful publishes no developer program, API reference, OpenAPI or GraphQL schema, SDK, CLI, Postman collection or webhook catalog. The single live machine surface on its domain is the RedwoodJS GraphQL endpoint at api.agrifulsoftware.com/graphql that backs its own single-page application; it answers anonymous requests but has introspection disabled in production and is documented nowhere.

providers.name: DaVinci Micro Fulfillment
providers.description: DaVinci Micro Fulfillment provides end‑to‑end eCommerce fulfillment solutions for direct‑to‑consumer brands. Leveraging a network of micro‑fulfillment centers across the United States, it enables same‑day, 1‑day, and 2‑day delivery, optimizing inventory placement, reducing costs, and improving customer experience. The company offers services including network planning, inventory management, order processing, and integration with major marketplaces such as Walmart.

providers.name: Finkargo
providers.description: Finkargo is a Latin American foreign-trade commerce platform that helps importers overcome the operational and financial barriers to growing their import businesses. Its product suite spans Paga (alternative supplier financing with revolving USD credit lines and 30-150 day terms), Analiza (market-intelligence dashboards that turn trade data into strategic decisions), Verifica (global supplier verification for product quality and legitimacy), and Protege (warehouse-to-warehouse cargo insurance). Operating across Colombia and Mexico and backed by QED Investors, Finkargo digitizes the full import-operations lifecycle from evaluating suppliers and planning imports to financing, transport, and arrival. Finkargo does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures the company's public product, legal, and security surfaces.

providers.name: Pavilion
providers.description: Pavilion is a government purchasing platform that helps public-sector buyers find vendors, get quotes, and buy what they need without the guesswork. It connects procurement teams at 3,500+ SLED (state, local, and education) agencies with qualified vendors, surfaces the most direct compliant route to purchase based on each agency's rules and existing cooperative contracts, and lets vendors claim a free supplier profile to get discovered. The product is 100% free for public agencies. Pavilion is a SaaS marketplace backed by Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: DeHaat
providers.description: DeHaat (Green Agrevolution Private Limited) is one of India's largest full-stack agritech platforms, connecting smallholder farmers from "seed to market" through a phygital network of 11,000+ DeHaat Centres and 503 Farmer Producer Organisations across 12+ agrarian states. Founded in 2012 by IIT/IIM alumni, the platform serves 1.8 million+ farmers with agri-inputs (seeds, fertilizers, crop protection), AI-enabled crop advisory in multiple regional languages for 30+ crops, soil analysis, crop-health monitoring, market linkage for harvested produce, and agri-financing. Backed by Prosus Ventures and others, DeHaat operates a franchisee micro-entrepreneur model that raises farmer net incomes 30-50% while making procurement more predictable for buyers. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures; the company publishes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so enrichment is limited to identity, corporate link-properties, and security posture.

providers.name: Railinc
providers.description: Railinc, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Association of American Railroads, delivers IT and information services to the North American freight rail industry. Railinc's suite of APIs empowers customers to simplify and automate business processes essential to the lifecycle of freight rail operations.

providers.name: SeaRates
providers.description: SeaRates provides global freight forwarding and logistics solutions, offering online tools for shipping quotes, tracking, and customs documentation. The company operates a digital platform that connects shippers with carriers, supporting air, sea, and road freight. SeaRates was acquired by DP World, integrating its services into a broader supply chain network, but continues to offer its branded portal for freight management and rate calculations.

providers.name: Walter
providers.description: Walter is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI employee for the manufacturing back office. Founded in 2026 by Nikolas Keller (CEO) and Lukas Postulka (CTO), Walter logs into the enterprise systems a company already runs on — SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Teams, Outlook and Gmail — the way a new hire would, and takes over manual paperwork: reading sales orders and purchase orders from emails and PDFs, capturing and validating the data, cross-checking it against the ERP, ordering from suppliers and catching pricing errors before they ship. It uses a purpose-built document-understanding model (rather than legacy template OCR) that supports 270+ languages and reaches 90%+ accuracy after minimal training, cutting an order that used to take 15 minutes down to about one. Walter requires no integration project and no rip-and-replace, operating the same screens the team already uses. It is an early-stage company with no public API, developer program, SDKs or documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bellhops
providers.description: Bellhops (branded as Bellhop) is a US technology-enabled moving-services company that operates an online booking platform for residential and commercial relocations. Customers get a free estimate and reserve local moves, long-distance relocations, hourly moving labor, packing help, and last-minute moves with no money down, then manage their reservation through an online dashboard staffed by background-checked movers. The company reports more than 300,000 completed moves and a 4.8/5 average rating across 20,000+ reviews. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Bellhops is a consumer-facing service with no publicly documented API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface as of this profile.

providers.name: BRKZ
providers.description: BRKZ is a Saudi Arabian construction-technology company operating a B2B online marketplace for building materials and construction equipment. Positioned as a top online building materials store in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), the platform connects contractors and construction businesses with material suppliers, streamlining procurement and offering nationwide delivery across Saudi Arabia. The bilingual (Arabic and English) storefront lets buyers source construction supplies online, and the company is backed by 500 Global among its investors. This profile was enriched from BRKZ's public web presence; the company runs a private, authenticated API host (api.brkz.com) but does not publish a public developer program, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: bttn
providers.description: bttn (bttn Inc., trading online as bttnusa.com) is a Seattle, Washington based business-to-business e-commerce marketplace and wholesale distributor of medical supplies, lab equipment and pharmaceuticals, selling name-brand consumables to clinics, dental, veterinary and physical-therapy practices, clinical laboratories, home-healthcare providers and other healthcare buyers across the United States. Founded in 2021 by JT Garwood and Jack Miller and backed by Tiger Global, the company operates a self-serve online storefront carrying 60,000+ catalog products with bulk and volume pricing, same- or next-business-day shipping, quote requests, purchase-order and invoice payment, shopping lists, quick-order pads and recurring reorder tooling. The storefront is a BigCommerce commerce back end fronted by a Catalyst/Next.js application. bttn publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract; its e-commerce surface is buyer-facing only.

providers.name: Club Feast
providers.description: Club Feast is a technology-enabled restaurant delivery and corporate catering company founded in 2020 by Atallah Atallah, Ghazi Atallah, and Chris Miao. It began as a subscription-based consumer meal service delivering signature dishes from neighborhood restaurants at deep discounts through a pre-order, scheduled batch-delivery model, and has since focused on corporate catering, group meal ordering with individual customization, event catering, and managed office pantry services for teams. Club Feast handles restaurant partnerships, menu curation, driver logistics, and delivery while employees select meals through its web app. The company raised seed funding led by General Catalyst and operates primarily in the San Francisco Bay Area. Club Feast does not currently publish a public developer API, portal, or specification; this profile tracks its company identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CLUBZERO
providers.description: CLUBZERO (CLUBZERØ) is a London-based reuse system administrator helping the food and beverage industry transition from single-use to reusable packaging. Its AI-powered platform serializes every reusable item with a GS1-standard QR, RFID, or barcode identifier, then coordinates the drop points, collection, washing, and redistribution logistics that keep packaging in circulation across on-trade, online delivery, and retail channels. CLUBZERO reports 95-98% return rates and 3.3M+ packaging rotations, running reuse programs for brands including McDonald's, Nestlé, Aramark, Compass Group, Just Eat, and the Wimbledon Championships. Backed by Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API surface is currently documented.

providers.name: CNC24
providers.description: CNC24 is a German online manufacturing platform for ordering custom CNC parts and precision components. Customers upload CAD files (STEP, STP, DWG, DXF, PDF and 3D data) and receive a binding quote within 48 hours, with production routed through a vetted network of 500+ manufacturers across 21 countries and roughly 5,500 machines. An AI-powered matching algorithm assigns each request to partners with the right expertise and production environment. Supported processes include CNC milling, turning, laser and waterjet cutting, sheet metal bending, punching, EDM, 3D printing, injection molding and die casting, serving aerospace, automotive, medical, robotics, construction and energy customers. The platform runs a fully digital workflow from quoting to delivery with order tracking, ISO 9001:2015 quality assurance, AES-256 encryption and anonymized drawings shared with partners. CNC24 is a Seedcamp portfolio company. No public developer API, SDKs or API documentation are published.

providers.name: Dimension
providers.description: Dimension is a nationwide, on-demand waste management and junk removal platform (formerly Trash Warrior) backed by 500 Global. It offers digital booking with instant AI-generated pricing (their "Mirror Mirror AI" quoter), same-day and next-day pickup for cardboard, appliances, mattresses, hazardous and medical waste, plus dumpster rentals, for both businesses and individuals. Every job includes tracking with detailed diversion data, receipts, and photos, and can be booked as a one-off or recurring service. Dimension has been awarded a State of California RFP contract for PPE waste removal. The company operates a customer-facing booking application and help center but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Fashinza
providers.description: Fashinza is a tech-enabled apparel manufacturing and supply-chain platform that connects fashion brands and retailers with a vetted global network of garment manufacturers. It streamlines end-to-end production: sourcing designs and fabrics, AI-powered supplier matching, tech-pack and sample creation, real-time production tracking, quality control, and merchandising and forecasting support so brands can move from design to delivery in shortened 30-45 day cycles. Backed by Accel and Prosus Ventures, the company operates a buyer login and a supplier onboarding surface but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: FIFOplus
providers.description: FIFOplus is a B2B smart-procurement marketplace for the HORECA sector (hotels, restaurants, cafes, and catering) in Saudi Arabia, connecting food-service buyers with suppliers across a webstore and mobile app that lists more than 5,000 food and non-food items spanning meat, seafood, dairy, produce, frozen goods, condiments, beverages, packaging, and cleaning supplies. The platform layers ordering, real-time order tracking, inventory, menu, and finance optimization with AI and integrates with point-of-sale systems and credit-terms payment. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Jeddah, FIFOplus operates across Jeddah, Makkah, Riyadh, and Taif and is backed by the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator (500 Global) and Palm Ventures. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; FIFOplus publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Fleek
providers.description: Fleek is a B2B wholesale marketplace for vintage and secondhand clothing that connects resellers with a global network of verified suppliers, letting new resellers, full-time resellers, and retail businesses source pre-owned inventory in bulk at wholesale margins. The platform aggregates more than a thousand secondhand suppliers worldwide, handles discovery, ordering, and logistics through its website and mobile apps, and is backed by HV Capital. Fleek operates a consumer/reseller storefront (built on Shopify) and a separate vendor onboarding flow for suppliers; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced from the HV Capital portfolio and enriched from Fleek's public web surface.

providers.name: Freterium
providers.description: Freterium is a cloud-native AI Transport Management System (TMS) and unified logistics operating system that connects shippers, carriers, and fleets on a single intelligent layer. It spans first-mile, middle-mile, and last-mile operations across eight integrated modules — order management, AI-powered route planning, collaborative shipper and carrier portals, real-time GPS tracking with predictive ETAs, fleet management, freight billing and costing, intelligent document control, and analytics and reporting — and exposes a documented REST API for ERP/WMS integration alongside 50+ off-the-shelf telematics and hardware integrations. Surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Partech portfolio company.

providers.name: HeavyConnect
providers.description: HeavyConnect is a digital documentation and compliance platform purpose-built for agricultural operations, serving growers, harvesters, shippers, and processors. Its mobile-first, offline-capable modules cover food safety compliance, worker training and certification, time and productivity tracking, quality assurance inspections, end-to-end traceability, and supplier management. The platform replaces paper-based recordkeeping with audit-ready digital documentation and real-time analytics dashboards, helping food and agriculture operations stay inspection-ready. HeavyConnect reports 2,600+ active users across operations including Sysco, Naturipe, Talley, and Empire. It is offered as a month-to-month subscription with a request-a-demo onboarding path. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a portfolio-company lead (500 Global, Techstars) and enriched from the company's public web presence; no public developer API or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Inhabitr
providers.description: Inhabitr is a Chicago-founded furnishing company that operates an AI-assisted furniture rental and procurement platform for commercial real estate and residential customers. Its business side (inhabitr.ai) furnishes hospitality, multifamily, student housing, short-term rental, co-living, senior living and office properties end to end — design, sourcing, procurement, delivery, installation and asset tracking — while its consumer storefront (inhabitr.com) rents furniture, sets and decor to households on flexible terms with a browser-based Home Designer tool. The company describes real-time connectivity to warehouses, manufacturers and retailers as the "furniture cloud" behind its bidding and fulfillment, but it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract of any kind as of this profiling pass.

providers.name: NuORDER
providers.description: NuORDER by Lightspeed is a global B2B commerce platform for wholesale buying and selling between brands and retailers. It combines a fully-branded wholesale eCommerce storefront with account-specific pricing and discounts, an Assortments planning tool for data-driven buying and reduced markdowns, and a Marketplace that connects buyers to 3,000+ brands across fashion, footwear, and apparel. NuORDER exposes a partner-gated REST API at api.nuorder.com for syncing products, orders, catalogs, and customer data with ERP, PIM, and other commerce systems. Acquired by Lightspeed in 2021, it is used by brands including Arc'teryx, Kendra Scott, TOMS, Barbour, and Canada Goose.

providers.name: Packmatic
providers.description: Packmatic is a Berlin-based packaging procurement platform that helps companies source flexible and paper-based packaging at lower cost. It combines a proprietary supplier database and a smart-matching engine spanning 350+ suppliers with expert packaging engineers and a cloud-based platform for managing quotes, orders, and supplier communication. Customers pay no upfront fees; Packmatic earns a commission when they source through its network, reporting average savings around 16% and reducing supplier search time by roughly 70%. Packmatic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Planet FWD
providers.description: Planet FWD is a decarbonization software platform that helps consumer brands measure, reduce, and report their carbon emissions. It provides AI-powered product life cycle assessments (LCAs), corporate greenhouse-gas inventories across Scope 1, 2, and 3, and supply-chain decarbonization scenario planning for food & beverage, retail, and apparel companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: Sciket
providers.description: Sciket (科研市集, operated by STAREK Scientific / 勢得科研股份有限公司) is Taiwan's specialized online marketplace for scientific research and technology procurement. The platform integrates thousands of global suppliers and millions of products — laboratory consumables and glassware, instruments and equipment, chemical reagents and materials, and industrial tools and hardware — into a single digitized purchasing, sourcing, and fast-shipment service for research labs, academic institutions, quality-control teams, and manufacturers. It offers enterprise purchasing, global sourcing, PunchOut system integration, monthly invoicing, and laboratory-construction services. Sciket runs an internal storefront/API host (api.sciket.com) but does not publish a public developer API program, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security data.

providers.name: Shippingbo
providers.description: Shippingbo is a Toulouse, France-based e-commerce logistics SaaS founded in 2016 by Marc Hericher and Romain Parent. The platform unifies an Order Management System (OMS), Warehouse Management System (WMS), and Transport Management System (TMS) behind a single REST API so that merchants, DNVBs, 3PLs, wholesalers, manufacturers, and marketplaces can centralize multi-channel orders, pilot warehouse picking and packing, and execute multi-carrier shipments from one back office. Shippingbo claims 5,000+ active users, 80 million orders, and EUR 5 billion in merchandise handled in 2024, with 2,500+ warehouses equipped across France and Europe. The Shippingbo Developer Portal (powered by Stoplight) exposes a public REST/JSON API covering orders, products, stocks, shipments, customers, pickings, and source connectors, secured by OAuth 2.0 through the oauth.shippingbo.com authorization server. Shippingbo additionally offers a dedicated TMS API for multi-carrier label generation and a webhook channel for order state changes, stock changes, and shipment events. Reported developer-facing scale includes 500+ developers, 10+ million orders processed through the APIs, 500+ million webhook deliveries, and 40+ pre-integrated carriers. Shippingbo is a French Tech company backed by IRDI Capital Investissement and GSO Innovation.

providers.name: Sourceday
providers.description: SourceDay is an AI-driven supplier collaboration and purchase order (PO) management platform for manufacturers and distributors. It synchronizes buyers, suppliers, and ERP systems in real time to prevent supply chain disruptions, automating PO change management, shipment visibility, supplier scorecards, and request-for-quote (RFQ) workflows. SourceDay reports managing more than $5B in quarterly direct spend across 100K+ activated suppliers, with 500+ certified ERP integrations spanning Acumatica, Epicor (Kinetic and Prophet 21), Infor, and NetSuite. Integration is delivered through certified ERP connectors rather than a public self-serve developer API; there is no public API documentation, developer portal, or published OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Tapstitch
providers.description: Tapstitch is a premium, fashion-focused print-on-demand (POD) and dropshipping platform that lets creators and brands design, produce, and sell custom apparel with no inventory, no minimums, and no subscription fees. It provides heavyweight streetwear blanks (250-400+ GSM), DTG and DTF printing, white-label fulfillment, and fashion collection development, with native integrations into Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Wix, Squarespace, and TikTok Shop for automatic product syncing, order routing, and fulfillment tracking. Founded to empower self-expression through clothing, Tapstitch has served 60,000+ creators, shipped over one million garments, and raised a $24.8M Series A led by Forerunner Ventures. Tapstitch does not currently publish a public developer/REST API for headless or custom storefronts; integration is delivered through its e-commerce platform apps and connectors.

providers.name: Tealet
providers.description: Tealet is a wholesale tea marketplace that connects independent tea growers and family farms directly with retailers and businesses. Buyers browse, trace, and order specialty teas sourced from family farms and cooperatives across 8 countries and 15 growing regions, with grower profiles, farm videos, subscription ordering, and a wholesale request flow that emphasize transparency and direct trade from source to cup. Tealet originated in Hawaii and is backed by 500 Startups and Blue Startups. The company operates a consumer/B2B web storefront with account sign-up, newsletter, and blog; it does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or an MCP server.

providers.name: Timberhub
providers.description: Timberhub is a European B2B timber trading platform that connects buyers with more than 70 sawmills across 28 countries. It offers timber sourcing with 24-hour quotes, built-in EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation) compliance automation, and AI-powered workflow automation spanning product matching, logistics, and compliance documentation. The company operates a login-gated web application at app.timberhub.com and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or machine-readable API documentation. Backed by Creandum, HV Capital, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: VOO (now SideUp)
providers.description: VOO was an Egyptian logistics marketplace that rebranded as SideUp in December 2022, relocating its headquarters to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SideUp is a fully integrated courier marketplace that lets e-commerce businesses ship locally and globally from one dashboard, connecting merchants with multiple courier services alongside payment gateways, shipping API integration, warehousing, and fulfillment, with plugins for Shopify, Salla, and OpenCart. Backed by 500 Global, Launch Africa VC, Riyadh Angels, and Alex Angels ($1.2M seed). No public developer portal or API documentation is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: YQN
providers.description: YQN is a global digital logistics platform and NVOCC / digital freight forwarder founded in 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. It lets shippers compare rates, book, and manage international sea freight, air freight, and rail freight, multimodal transport, trucking, customs clearance, cargo insurance, and overseas warehousing online. YQN operates 25+ global branches across North America, Latin America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East with 1,500+ employees, 300+ shipping and airline partners, and 3,500+ supplier resources. It integrates directly with carriers such as Lufthansa Cargo via carrier APIs for rate-checking, allotment booking, and digital bill-of-lading generation. YQN holds FIATA, IATA, and NVOCC certifications, but publishes no public developer API portal or documentation.

providers.name: AEG Fuels
providers.description: AEG Fuels (Associated Energy Group, LLC) is a Miami, Florida-based global aviation fuel supply, logistics and trip-support company that has served commercial air carriers, business and general aviation operators, FBOs and government aircraft since 1988. It arranges jet fuel uplifts at more than 3,000 locations across 197 countries and layers ancillary services on top of supply: flight support (flight planning, ground handling, overflight and landing permits, on-site supervision, coordination of third-party services), fuel management for airlines, tax recovery and VAT exemption, a Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) program, marine fuel and land fuel, the Carnet fuel card, the AEG Rewards loyalty program, and the AEG Connect network for FBOs and bulk fuel distribution. Customers transact through the company's own MILO ordering platform - a browser client portal at app.aegfuels.com and iOS/Android apps for quoting, ordering, authorizing and reviewing fuel transactions. As of this profile AEG Fuels publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; the digital surface is an end-user product, not a platform.

providers.name: Blume Global
providers.description: Blume Global provides a cloud-based supply chain visibility platform that empowers partners across logistics, manufacturing, and distribution to detect risks early, act decisively, and protect performance. Their solutions include real-time visibility, strategic sourcing, part quality management, and carrier integrations, helping enterprises streamline operations and improve decision-making throughout the supply chain.

providers.name: Branddu
providers.description: Branddu (Branddu Colombia / Branddu AI) is a B2B MerchTech platform that digitizes corporate merchandising and promotional-product procurement across Latin America. Operating in Colombia and Mexico, it centralizes the full purchasing workflow - product discovery, inventory, quotations, customization, online design, and checkout - through a single online catalog of more than 15,000 fully customizable products across 46+ categories. Branddu AI (formed via a merger with Reno) combines AI, proprietary software, and a regional supplier network to simplify how companies source branded merchandise. The public storefront runs on Shopify. The company is backed by a US$300K pre-seed from 500 Global, bringing total capital raised to roughly US$800K.

providers.name: IgniteTech
providers.description: IgniteTech is a global, AI-first enterprise software company (headquartered in Austin, Texas, and operating remote-first across 30+ countries) that acquires, revitalizes, and supports mission-critical enterprise software and embeds AI-powered capabilities across its portfolio — an operating model the company brands "AI-DNA." Its Native AI products include Eloquens AI (automated, context-aware email response), MyPersonas (AI digital clones of key employees that answer repetitive questions via a video chat-style interface), and Adminio AI (meeting scheduling through intelligent email orchestration). The IgniteTech Unlimited software library spans acquired enterprise brands such as GFI Software, Khoros (Communities and Care), Jive, DNN, Gensym, Computron, GRID (supply chain, via the Suuchi acquisition), Knova, AnswerHub, ACORN, TradeBeam, and SalesBuilder. Led by CEO Eric Vaughan, the company positions itself as an AI enterprise software company rather than only a software holding company.

providers.name: Nabu
providers.description: Nabu is an AI-powered customs clearance platform that automates international trade compliance end to end. It collects shipment data from emails, PDFs, Excel files, databases, and TMS records via API, EDI, SFTP, or email, prepares complete compliant customs files, and generates pre-filled import/export declarations ready for submission in standard customs software. Nabu targets customs brokers and declaration teams, offering autonomous processing, workload flexibility to absorb staffing gaps, and full auditability across multiple regions and local regulatory regimes. Backed by Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: Trackonomy
providers.description: Trackonomy provides smart label technology for supply chain visibility, enabling real‑time tracking, predictive maintenance, and workflow optimization across industries. Their platform connects devices, sensors, and data streams to deliver actionable insights, improve asset protection, and streamline logistics operations. Backed by 8vc, Trackonomy serves enterprises seeking to digitize and secure their supply chain.

providers.name: CoreChain Technologies
providers.description: CoreChain Technologies provides a scalable, secure B2B payments network and supply chain finance solutions. With over $1 billion in payments processed, the platform integrates with major ERPs, offers working‑capital lines, and is SOC‑2 compliant, targeting enterprises seeking to reduce fraud, lower operating costs, and automate vendor payments.

providers.name: Diagon
providers.description: Diagon is a California-based industrial equipment sourcing company building Albus, an equipment intelligence platform for manufacturing buyers and sellers. Buyers search across millions of industrial equipment listings, compare models, specifications, pricing and availability, and connect directly with sellers; sellers publish AI-powered catalogs, reach qualified buyer demand, and see live equipment searches in real time. Diagon indexes manufacturing equipment products, suppliers and service providers, bringing hardware, services and financing into a consolidated procurement experience. Founded by a team out of Tesla, Bright Machines, Rivian and Snackpass, and backed by Anthemis under its data, tech and infrastructure thesis. Diagon publishes no public developer API today; its /api surface is an authenticated first-party application API (Clerk-based session auth) and is disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Forterro
providers.description: Forterro is a pan-European industrial software company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in London, that provides enterprise resource planning (ERP) and specialised business software to the industrial mid-market. Built through a series of acquisitions, Forterro operates a portfolio of regional and vertical ERP brands - including Abas, Jeeves, Garp, Proconcept, Sylob, Silog, Myfactory, Orderwise, Clipper, 123Insight, BPSC, Helios, Proffix, Prodaso and its cloud-native Fortee product - alongside best-in-class point solutions such as warehouse management (WMS), point of sale (POS), material requirements planning (MRP) and business intelligence. The company serves more than 13,000 industrial businesses across manufacturing, warehousing, wholesale and retail from 40+ offices worldwide.

providers.name: Highstock
providers.description: Highstock is a private, AI-native wholesale marketplace that connects consumer brands holding excess or unsold inventory with a vetted network of global business buyers. Focused initially on beauty and personal care, the platform lets brands convert surplus stock into cash while protecting brand value and channel privacy, and gives buyers access to authentic inventory directly from brands at exclusive pricing, with centralized order management and flexible payment terms. The company reports 50+ beauty and personal care brands, 100+ wholesale buyers, $100M+ in listed inventory, and more than 1M pounds of product diverted from landfill, with offices in New York (US) and Gurgaon (India). Highstock does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Leta
providers.description: Leta is a pan-African logistics technology company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya, with operations across Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa. Leta builds an AI-driven delivery management platform that helps businesses move goods cheaper and faster while minimising climate impact: route optimization, automated dispatch and broadcast, live GPS track-and-trace, payment on delivery, fleet management, and delivery analytics. The platform is delivered as logistics SaaS plus on-demand and dedicated rider services, including an M-PESA business mini-app, and serves e-commerce, third-party logistics and courier, food and beverage, retail and consumer goods, and pharmacy and healthcare delivery operators. Leta is backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: Pillar
providers.description: Pillar is an Italian construction-technology company, founded in 2025 and headquartered in Milan, building what it calls the operating system for the construction industry (il sistema operativo per l'edilizia). Its cloud platform unifies the back office of building firms (imprese edili) — invoicing (fatturazione), cash-flow management (flussi di cassa), bank reconciliation, quotes and estimates (preventivi), procurement, job and project cost control (gestione commessa), and delivery notes and site work reports (DDT e rapportini) — alongside on-site safety (Pillar Sicurezza) and an AI layer (Pillar AI) that automates data entry in real time, including inputs captured from the job site over WhatsApp. Pillar is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital and today reaches customers through a book-a-demo model rather than a public self-serve signup or a developer-facing API; no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Scoutbee
providers.description: Scoutbee is an AI-powered supplier discovery and procurement intelligence platform that helps enterprise buyers instantly find, vet, and connect with trusted suppliers. Founded in 2015 in Berlin, Germany, Scoutbee uses large language models, knowledge-graph technology, and a global supplier network to power supplier discovery, sourcing project execution (Streamline), and a centralized supplier data foundation (DeepSee), surfaced through the Scoutbee Intelligence Platform. Its AI gives procurement, sourcing, and category-management teams recommendations for suppliers matched on qualifications, risk, certifications, sustainability, diversity, cost, and experience. Scoutbee integrates with SAP Ariba guided sourcing and, following its October 2025 acquisition by Coupa, is being embedded into the Coupa Supplier Portal. Scoutbee does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Storyboard
providers.description: Storyboard is a fleet-operations AI platform that gives trucking and logistics companies voice-first, hands-free AI workers for their drivers. The system automates dispatch updates, driver coaching, safety alerts, and compliance monitoring (including hours-of-service and idling) so back-office teams field fewer phone calls and drivers stay hands-free on the road. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Santa Monica, California, Storyboard began as an enterprise podcast and internal-audio communication platform (a $4.5M seed round led by CRV in 2020) before pivoting to AI-powered fleet operations. It is distributed through in-cab telematics marketplaces such as Platform Science and ISAAC Instruments. Storyboard exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; access is via its web and mobile apps at app.storyboard.com. This profile was surfaced as a CRV portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Tenkara
providers.description: Tenkara is an AI-powered operations and supply chain platform for material manufacturers across food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, beverages, and OTC products. The platform automates 75+ workflows spanning supplier sourcing and qualification, procurement, freight and logistics booking, order tracking, and compliance documentation (COA, SDS, and audit records), helping manufacturers find better suppliers faster, prevent delays, and run more efficient operations. Tenkara is backed by True Ventures.

providers.name: thecompanyatlas-com
providers.description: The Company Atlas aggregates customs trade data from 36 international markets, offering tools to look up individual import and export declarations, rank companies behind products or routes, and explore detailed trade records. Data spans from 2012 to 2026 across registries such as Australia ABN, US Colorado, Hong Kong, UK Companies House, and many others, providing comprehensive insights for businesses, researchers, and analysts.

providers.name: hogarmas-net
providers.description: Hogar Mas is a Chilean B2B wholesale marketplace that aggregates price lists from local suppliers across categories such as food, beverages, cleaning, personal care, and more. It enables businesses to compare unit prices, quantity tiers, and delivery conditions, sourcing data from over 70 public providers and presenting searchable catalogs for bulk purchasing.

providers.name: Sigma Healthcare
providers.description: Sigma Healthcare is an Australian healthcare company that describes itself as a leading network of independent and franchised pharmacies across Australia, with a heritage spanning over 110 years. Its site presents its pharmacy brands (including Chemist Warehouse), a wholesale business with a pharmaceutical distribution network, 3PL/4PL logistics services, supplier programs and community pharmacy accounts, plus an investor centre and the Sigma Connect ordering portal. Added from the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: australia-apidays-2026); no public developer API is advertised on its website.

providers.name: Sirius
providers.description: beSirius is an Amsterdam-based AI platform for the critical minerals and metals value chain. It builds a continuously verified digital Twin of every supplier, mapping each company's data to the frameworks, questionnaires, and regulations its buyers, auditors, and regulators require - including CSDDD, CMRT/EMRT/AMRT conflict-minerals reporting, EcoVadis, CDP, S&P CSA, UN Global Compact, LME Passport, and the Consolidated Mining Standard Initiative (CMSI). The platform automates supplier due diligence, sustainability and ESG data collection and verification, certification readiness, customer KYC, and ratings improvement across mining, processing, and trading supply chains, reducing manual audit and disclosure effort. beSirius is backed by Techstars and other investors.

providers.name: Sunyur
providers.description: Sunyur (商越科技 / Beijing Sunyur Network Technology Co., Ltd, 北京商越网络科技有限公司) is a Chinese enterprise procurement digitalization company providing AI-driven procurement solutions for large and medium enterprises. Its products include an intelligent procurement middle-platform (采购中台), an SRM supplier relationship management system, an e-procurement SaaS platform, and a procurement mall (采购商城), helping each customer build a dedicated online, digital, and intelligent enterprise procurement platform to raise efficiency and lower cost. Sunyur operates an open integration platform ("聚贤阁", open.sunyur.com) that connects enterprises to 30+ mainstream e-commerce platforms and 10+ third-party applications through a single accessToken-authenticated API surface. Sunyur is backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: US Foods
providers.description: US Foods is one of the largest foodservice distributors in the United States, serving restaurants, healthcare facilities, hospitality businesses, government institutions, and educational facilities. As a Fortune 500 company, US Foods operates a national distribution network with over 70 distribution centers and serves approximately 250,000 customers. The company's digital platform includes the MOXe eCommerce application for ordering and business management, EDI integration for B2B transactions, and a supplier PIM system for product data synchronization. US Foods has undergone significant digital transformation building a data mesh architecture on Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and cloud platforms to support its eCommerce and supply chain operations.

providers.name: Waystation
providers.description: Waystation provides AI‑powered sourcing solutions for consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies. By connecting directly to procurement inboxes, it automatically extracts certificates of analysis, spec sheets, and supplier data from email threads, eliminating manual data entry and reducing coordination tax. The platform streamlines quote capture, RFP creation, and supplier performance tracking, delivering up to ten‑fold ROI and faster sourcing cycles for its customers.

providers.name: Aily Labs
providers.description: Aily Labs is a Munich-based enterprise AI company that builds an AI Decision Intelligence Suite — a platform that connects siloed internal and external data to deliver real-time, explainable predictions and recommendations across Finance, R&D, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Go-To-Market, Procurement, and People functions. The suite ships with 300+ validated predictive models and an iOS app, and is deployed across Healthcare & Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Luxury & Fashion, Media & Tech, Retail, and Services (clients include Sanofi). Aily Labs is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Defense Logistics Agency
providers.description: The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is the U.S. Department of Defense combat support agency that manages a global supply chain spanning roughly five million items in nine supply chains plus storage, distribution, fuel, construction, and disposition missions. DLA operates an extensive catalog of business applications used by suppliers, the military services, and federal partners. Most DLA applications require account registration and operate behind authentication; public-facing surfaces include the DLA Internet Bid Board System (DIBBS), the DLA Disposition Services storefront, the FedMall procurement marketplace, and federated logistics search tools.

providers.name: GoodShip
providers.description: GoodShip is a freight orchestration and procurement platform for shippers, brokers, and asset-based carriers. It unifies TMS tender, contract-award, and location data, enriches it with real-time market rates, and layers AI-assisted bid analysis (via its Laney AI transportation analyst), lane- and carrier-level performance analytics, carrier scorecards, and in-app collaboration on top. Teams run mini-bids and full-network RFPs, benchmark spend against the market, and take corrective action without dedicated developer resources. Plug-and-play with major transportation management systems; backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and serving US and Canadian operations.

providers.name: MTech Systems
providers.description: MTech Systems provides full supply chain data management with artificial intelligence and business intelligence functionality for poultry and animal protein producers, including the Amino, Sonar, Proline, and Axis products.

providers.name: SEKO Logistics
providers.description: SEKO Logistics is a global logistics provider offering freight forwarding, customs clearance, warehousing, and last‑mile delivery services. It serves customers worldwide across multiple regions, providing integrated supply‑chain solutions, e‑commerce fulfillment, and specialized logistics for industries such as healthcare and technology. The company emphasizes technology‑driven visibility, sustainability, and compliance with international trade regulations.

providers.name: Shopee
providers.description: Shopee is Southeast Asia's largest e-commerce marketplace, operated by Sea Limited and active across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan, and select markets in Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile) and Europe (Spain, Poland). Shopee Open Platform (open.shopee.com) exposes a partner / seller-facing REST API (v2) covering shop configuration, product / SKU management, order processing, logistics and shipping label generation, returns and refunds, discounts and vouchers, payments, push notifications, and global cross-border product management. Authentication uses a partner ID + partner key with per-shop access tokens issued via OAuth- style shop authorization.

providers.name: Tasso
providers.description: Tasso, Inc. designs painless, needle-free blood collection devices and an end-to-end logistics platform for decentralized and at-home blood sampling. Its product line includes Tasso+ for capillary whole-blood collection, the Tasso-M20/Mini for dried blood microsampling, and the tile-T20 for liquid serum and plasma, enabling remote specimen collection for clinical trials, patient screening, diagnostics, and research. Tasso pairs the hardware with kitting, shipping, and sample-return logistics and is cited in over 100 peer-reviewed publications. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Agraga
providers.description: Agraga (operated by Virya Logistics Technologies Private Limited) is a Chennai, India based digital cross-border logistics platform founded in 2021 by Anoop Raghavan and Venkatesh Narayanaswamy. It positions itself as a single operator for every leg of a shipment, bringing ocean freight, air freight, domestic transport, customs broking, warehousing, e-commerce fulfilment and embedded trade finance onto one booking and tracking platform aimed at underserved Indian MSME exporters and importers. It reports 700+ customers and 1,000+ vendors across 40-plus markets, and raised INR 100 crore in a pre-Series B round led by Bajaj Finserv with IvyCap Ventures. As of this profile Agraga publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable API contract; its platform backends are private and answer every anonymous request with an authentication error.

providers.name: Asseta
providers.description: Asseta is a San Francisco-based online marketplace for the secondary market in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. Founded in 2013, the platform lets fabs, refurbishers, and dealers list and discover used, refurbished, and new components, ranging from chamber assemblies and power supplies to smaller parts like o-rings, with more than 450,000 listings from suppliers around the world. Buyers request quotes from global suppliers with a single click and typically save 50-60% versus OEM pricing. Asseta is a portfolio company of a16z and Y Combinator. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its published web properties.

providers.name: Beeline Bikes
providers.description: Beeline Bikes (now operating as Beeline Connect) is a B2B software platform for the bicycle industry that links riders, retailers, and brands across North America, with roughly 3,300 participating retailers. The platform provides real-time service scheduling and 24/7 appointment booking, live market inventory management, test-ride booking, local bicycle assembly coordination, warranty submission and reimbursement tracking, an affiliate e-commerce sales channel with revenue sharing to local dealers, and a dynamic dealer locator. It supports both mobile and in-shop retail operations and serves established brands such as Aventon, Priority, Lectric, and Pedego. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or integration surface has been found at this time.

providers.name: Ejen2u
providers.description: Ejen2u is a Malaysian reseller and agent-management technology company that operates one of the country's largest cloud-based reseller ecosystems for MSME brand owners, stockists, agents, dropshippers, and affiliates. Its platform spans EjenGO, a digital reseller and stockist management system; WEMAP, an entrepreneurial education program; and EjenVenture, custom reseller-network solutions for corporate brands, alongside fintech and logistics integrations (Pos Laju, Boost, Curlec, Delyva, J&T). Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seri Kembangan, Ejen2u is backed by 500 Global, Gobi Partners, and Artem Ventures, and has facilitated hundreds of millions of ringgit in reseller commerce across a network of hundreds of thousands of agents. It exposes no public developer API today; this profile is an API Evangelist network entry enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Mottu
providers.description: Mottu is the leading motorcycle-rental ecosystem in Latin America, founded in 2020 in Sao Paulo, Brazil by Rubens Zanelatto. It rents motorcycles to gig and delivery couriers who lack access to traditional credit, bundling insurance, maintenance, 24-hour support and financial services (Mottu Pay) so workers can earn income through food delivery, e-commerce and last-mile logistics. Mottu has verticalized the value chain, running its own assembly line, parts and service network, and fleet-management software, and offers white-labeled last-mile delivery (Mottu Entregas) to more than 1,000 retailers across 100+ cities in Brazil and Mexico. Backed by QED Investors, Mottu has raised over US$150M. It operates as a consumer and B2B mobility/fintech app and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Rex Airlines
providers.description: Rex Airlines (Regional Express, IATA ZL / ICAO RXA) is Australia's second-largest regional carrier, headquartered in Mascot, New South Wales, flying a Saab 340 fleet to roughly 45 regional destinations across every Australian state. Formed in 2002 from the merger of Hazelton and Kendell Airlines, Rex entered voluntary administration in July 2024 and was acquired by US holding company Air T in December 2025 with Australian federal government debt support. In the distribution chain Rex is the inventory owner, not an intermediary — it runs Sabre's SabreSonic passenger service suite (inventory, reservations, ticketing, ancillaries, check-in) per Sabre's February 2021 announcement, sells direct through its own ASP.NET booking engine at ibe2.rex.com.au, and reaches trade through a web-only Travel Agent portal gated on an IATA, DAPA or TIDS agency number. Its API posture is honest to state plainly: no developer portal, no public documentation, no OpenAPI, and no NDC claim anywhere on rex.com.au. The only published trace of a programmatic interface is a bare "Request API Access" checkbox on the agent registration form — accreditation required, contract unspecified, nothing documented, and no exit path beyond a privacy-law request to the Customer Contact Centre.

providers.name: Sustaira
providers.description: Sustaira is a modular, AI-powered sustainability and ESG application platform built on a low-code architecture in partnership with Mendix. Customers use Sustaira to run carbon accounting (Scope 1, 2, and 3), ESG disclosure and reporting aligned to CSRD, CDP, PCAF, and SASB, sustainability project and KPI tracking, supply chain data collection, and industry-specific sustainability workflows across construction, finance, logistics, healthcare, and other sectors. Integration into customer systems is handled through web services and APIs on the underlying Mendix platform, plus a marketplace of 150+ sustainability accelerators. Sustaira does not publish a public, self-service developer API portal; integration access is delivered through customer enterprise contracts and partner programs.

providers.name: trawa
providers.description: trawa (operated by Future Energy Services GmbH) is a Berlin-based energy management company that helps mid-sized businesses procure and manage electricity. It pairs AI-optimized green-electricity sourcing on the wholesale market with cloud energy-management software that gives customers real-time visibility into consumption, costs, and CO2 emissions, alongside battery storage and smart control of energy-consuming assets such as CHP plants and charging stations. Founded in 2022, trawa is backed by Balderton Capital and Speedinvest. The platform is delivered through a customer web portal and a trust center; no public developer API was found as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Wakeo
providers.description: Wakeo is a Paris-based SaaS platform for real-time multimodal supply-chain visibility across sea, air, road, rail, and parcel. It combines carrier, telematics, and AIS tracking data with data-science predictions to deliver predictive door-to-door ETAs, milestone events, congestion and disruption alerts, carbon-footprint reporting, and route reliability scoring. Wakeo's REST API and webhooks let customers pull transport orders and push enriched ETAs and tracking updates into a TMS, ERP, or MRP. The API is enterprise and customer-provisioned - the reference at docs.wakeo.co is behind a password wall and access is granted by Wakeo Customer Success or support@wakeo.co.

providers.name: Ailumia
providers.description: Ailumia is an AI-driven retail operations platform that helps brands and sellers grow on the world's most valuable marketplaces, with a focus on Amazon. The platform applies artificial intelligence across the retail workflow to manage marketplace sales, inventory, supply chain, and finances, giving operators data-driven guidance and automation to navigate the challenges of modern e-commerce. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Ailumia is backed by 500 Global. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio; enrichment probing found a Cloudflare-fronted WordPress marketing presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Carlisle Companies
providers.description: Carlisle Companies Incorporated (NYSE: CSL) is a global diversified manufacturer of highly engineered building envelope products and solutions, serving commercial and residential construction, insulation, roofing, waterproofing, and specialty markets. Carlisle's primary operating segment is Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM), which includes brands such as Carlisle SynTec Systems, Hunter Panels, Henry Company, MB Technology, and WIP Industrial. Carlisle does not publish a public developer API; distributors and direct contractors transact through the Carlisle Customer Success Portal, and commercial trading partners integrate with Carlisle using standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 855, 856, 810) over AS2/SFTP.

providers.name: Drayalliance
providers.description: Drayalliance provides a technology platform that simplifies drayage logistics for shippers and carriers. Their solution offers real‑time container visibility, automated appointment scheduling, cost‑saving rate negotiations, and end‑to‑end management of drayage operations. By integrating directly with port terminals and offering API access, they enable customers to track shipments, reduce demurrage and detention fees, and improve overall supply‑chain predictability.

providers.name: Root Global
providers.description: Root Global is a Berlin-based climate technology company building decarbonization infrastructure for the food and beverage supply chain. Founded in 2022 and backed by Point Nine, its carbon operating system lets food processors, manufacturers, and retailers collect farm-level emissions data at scale, calculate corporate and product carbon footprints, and launch tailored reduction plans with their farming partners. Results are GUTcert certified and SBTi compliant, with the platform supporting operations across 11+ European countries. Root Global exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Dianxiaomi
providers.description: Dianxiaomi (店小秘) is a free cross-border e-commerce ERP platform operated by Shenzhen Meiyunji Network Technology Co., Ltd., serving more than 1.8 million cross-border sellers worldwide. It unifies product listing and data collection, multi-platform order processing, warehouse and inventory management, procurement, financial and profit analytics, and customer service across 70+ marketplaces including AliExpress, Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop, with integrations to 1,700+ logistics providers and 130+ overseas warehouses. The platform is user-facing SaaS; no public developer/API open platform is currently published.

providers.name: Helloworld Travel
providers.description: Helloworld Travel Limited (ASX: HLO) is an Australian travel distribution group headquartered in Sydney, operating retail agency networks, corporate travel, wholesale packaging, air ticket consolidation and inbound tour operations across Australia, New Zealand, Fiji and Europe with more than 700 staff and over 2,700 retail members. It sits on the demand side of the travel distribution chain — an aggregator and reseller of third-party air, hotel and land content rather than an inventory owner — reaching travellers through its member agencies and reaching air supply through GDS-based consolidation and ticketing (Air Tickets, Express Tickets, SmartTickets). Its API posture is closed. There is no public developer portal, no OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI or Postman artifact, and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Every trade system is behind an agent login — ReadyRooms (B2B hotel and activity booking), AOTonline.net (inbound trade booking engine), Air Tickets and Express Tickets. A developer host is provisioned at developer.readyrooms.com.au but returns HTTP 401 with a Basic auth challenge on every path probed, so access is partner-only. There is no published exit path — the only documented way to get data back is a Privacy Act access request to the Helloworld Privacy Officer.

providers.name: Melonn
providers.description: Melonn is a third-party logistics (3PL) and multichannel fulfillment operator for e-commerce businesses across Colombia and Mexico. Through its proprietary Órbita platform it centralizes inventory, processes and packs orders, manages returns, and offers same/next-day delivery, unifying multiple sales channels into a single operation. Melonn connects to platforms such as Shopify, VTEX, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, MercadoLibre, Amazon, Walmart, Rappi, TikTok Shop, Liverpool, and Coppel, and exposes a REST API with real-time webhooks so any external platform can drive order management, inventory queries, shipment tracking, and returns. Melonn was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors. Public developer documentation and a sandbox are provided on request via the Melonn advisory/contact form rather than an open developer portal.

providers.name: Stockland
providers.description: Stockland is one of Australia's largest diversified property groups (ASX-listed), describing itself as "Australia's largest community creator". It owns, manages and develops retail town centres, workplace and logistics assets, and residential and land lease communities (including Halcyon), with more than $17.9 billion of real estate assets according to its own About page. It was surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (australia-apidays-2026); no public developer portal or API documentation was found on stockland.com.au.

providers.name: Terminal Logistics
providers.description: Terminal Industries (Terminal Logistics) is the company behind the Terminal Yard Operating System (YOS), an AI-native, fully-integrated platform for yard operations across logistics and supply chain. It unifies gate management, carrier risk assessment and driver ID, dispatch and spotter orchestration, yard visibility, load verification, carrier appointments, and end-to-end yard security from the gate to the dock, using computer vision and agentic AI. It serves third-party logistics, retail and grocery, consumer packaged goods, refrigerated warehousing, contract carriers, manufacturing facilities, and drop lots. Backed by 8vc. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and status surface.

providers.name: Zageno
providers.description: ZAGENO is a multi-supplier e-commerce marketplace and procurement platform for pharma and life-science R&D labs. It lets scientists search, compare, and order more than 50 million SKUs from over 6,000 global suppliers through a single consolidated catalog and checkout, with real-time availability, spend visibility, and automated approval workflows. ZAGENO connects into enterprise procure-to-pay and ERP systems (Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Procurify, NetSuite, QuickBooks and more) through a single PunchOut/cXML catalog integration rather than a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, it is backed by General Catalyst, Grazia Equity, and Capnamic Ventures.

providers.name: Commonwealth Joe
providers.description: Commonwealth Joe Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee company based in Washington, D.C., offering freshly roasted beans, cold brew, and coffee‑as‑a‑service for offices and retail customers. They operate retail cafés, an online shop, and wholesale programs, emphasizing sustainability and community values. Their website provides product catalogs, subscription options, a blog, and corporate information, but no public API documentation is currently available.

providers.name: Freshop
providers.description: Freshop is an eCommerce platform purpose-built for grocery and specialty retail, now part of NCR Voyix. It powers branded online storefronts, mobile shopping, order fulfillment, pickup, and delivery for independent and regional grocers, and integrates third-party services for loyalty, coupons, email, SMS, and fulfillment. Freshop exposes a live REST API at api.freshop.com that serves store and product data to Freshop-powered storefronts and apps, authenticated with an application key (app_key) query-string parameter and versioned by a numeric path segment.

providers.name: Metalshub
providers.description: Metalshub (Metals Hub GmbH) is a Berlin-based digital platform for the metals, mining, and recycling industries, enabling over 2,800 industry participants to buy, sell, and trade raw materials online. Its procurement, sales, and tolling solutions help companies source ferroalloys, minor metals, noble alloys, and recycled materials, discover new suppliers and customers, run digital tenders and auctions, and manage the full transaction lifecycle from negotiation to contract. Backed by Point Nine and other investors, Metalshub operates a login-gated trading application at trade.metals-hub.com. No public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: XPO Logistics
providers.description: XPO Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of less-than-truckload (LTL) transportation in North America. The company offers freight transportation through a proprietary network of service centers and uses technology to drive efficiency for more than 50,000 customers. XPO Logistics historically operated as part of XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO), the publicly traded company that spun off GXO Logistics (contract logistics) in 2021 and RXO (brokerage) in 2022, leaving XPO focused on LTL trucking. XPO Logistics does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged through enterprise account managers.

providers.name: China Southern Air Logistics
providers.description: China Southern Air Logistics Co., Ltd. (南航物流, CSAL) is the air cargo and logistics arm of China Southern Airlines, established in December 2018 and headquartered in Guangzhou. It combines the airline's freighter fleet with passenger belly capacity into an integrated air logistics network, and sells express (CZ Speed), standard, special cargo, whole-aircraft charter, intermodal truck and door-to-door products through its Tang (唐翼) online cargo system at cargo.csair.com, where agents and shippers book capacity, query freight rates, track air waybills, manage dangerous-goods accounts and request invoices. As of this profile the company publishes no developer program, no public API reference and no machine-readable specification; system-to-system integration is arranged bilaterally with agents and forwarders.

providers.name: Freightos
providers.description: Freightos (NASDAQ CRGO) operates a global freight booking marketplace and, through WebCargo by Freightos, a rate-management and eBooking platform used by freight forwarders and carriers to price and book air, ocean, and trucking shipments in real time across 55+ carriers. Freightos publishes a developer portal (developers.freightos.com / developer.freightos.com) with freight-rate estimation, HS-code duties classification, and CO2 emissions APIs, plus the public Shipping Calculator on the marketplace. Bookable live rates, eBooking, and shipment tracking are offered to forwarder, carrier, and TMS/ERP partners under commercial agreements. Most developer-portal APIs are documented as beta and provided as-is, and full access is provisioned per partner rather than via open self-service signup.

providers.name: Freshket
providers.description: Freshket is a Thai agri-food supply chain technology company that operates a B2B online marketplace connecting farmers and food producers directly with restaurants, hotels, catering operations, and food manufacturers. The platform uses technology to manage the fresh-produce and ingredient supply chain more efficiently and transparently, giving buyers quality ingredients at fair prices with reliable next-day delivery while giving growers better market access and pricing. Founded in Bangkok and backed by 500 Global, Freshket covers ordering, sourcing, cold-chain logistics, and account management for foodservice businesses across Thailand. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as of this enrichment pass Freshket publishes a customer-facing web and mobile ordering platform but no public developer API, SDKs, or documented API surface.

providers.name: Harbor Lab
providers.description: Harbor Lab is an AI-powered port cost and disbursement account (DA) management platform for the maritime industry, headquartered in Athens, Greece. Its cloud software helps shipowners, ship managers, charterers, and port agents manage port calls, validate and approve disbursement accounts, benchmark and negotiate port service pricing across a marketplace of thousands of port service providers, and automate payment and settlement — improving operational efficiency, digitizing the process, and delivering cost transparency across port cost management. The company is backed by Speedinvest, VentureFriends, Atomico, and others. As of this profile Harbor Lab exposes a web dashboard product only; no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Juxta
providers.description: Juxta is a San Francisco positioning-technology company building a hardware-free Universal Positioning System (UPS) that delivers real-time indoor and outdoor tracking for people, assets, and robots with sub-meter accuracy indoors and roughly 3-meter accuracy outdoors. Rather than relying on satellites, beacons, or cameras, Juxta uses the inertial (IMU) sensors already present in mobile devices, robots, and machinery combined with machine-learning "synthetic fingerprinting" to map and track subjects in GPS-denied environments such as warehouses, hospitals, underground facilities, and battlefields. Its drag-and-drop deployment ingests a floorplan, satellite image, or CAD file and goes live in hours, priced by mapped area and assets tracked. Juxta serves defense, logistics and robotics, and healthcare, and is backed by Y Combinator and other early-stage investors. Access today is through a partner portal and booked demo; no public developer API is documented.

providers.name: Kyrok
providers.description: Kyrok GmbH is a Berlin-based software company building an AI operating system for mid-sized pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers in Europe. The platform layers over a company's existing ERP (SAP S/4HANA, SAP R/3, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, Applus) and connects the systems supply chain teams currently hold together by hand into intelligent operations across customer service, production planning, material planning and procurement. Kyrok positions itself on an "AI assists, people decide" model, running on European infrastructure in Frankfurt am Main, GDPR-compliant, with ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications in progress. The company announced a EUR 3.1M round in June 2026 and names AnalytiChem and Konapharma as customers. Kyrok connects to ERP systems via API but publishes no public developer API, API reference, or SDKs as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: NICKL
providers.description: NICKL (Nicklpass) is a subscription management platform that bills itself as "the operating system for subscriptions." It helps organizations govern the digital tools, SaaS subscriptions, and data services their teams use by connecting identity, usage, and procurement data in one place. Capabilities include role-based governance and provisioning, usage intelligence to surface adoption and redundant spend, and coordinated procurement that aggregates demand to negotiate from real usage data. The platform integrates with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Plaid, and applies AI models for insights and pricing optimization. NICKL participated in the Comcast NBCUniversal LIFT Labs Accelerator powered by Techstars.
